Who can number the clouds by wisdom, or who can tilt the waterskins of the heavens,
when the dust hardens into a mass and the clods cleave fast together? “
Can you hunt the prey for the lion, or satisfy the craving of the young lions,
when they crouch in their dens or lie in wait in the thicket?
Who provides for the raven its food, when its young cry to God for help and wander for lack of sustenance?”
Do you know the season in which the mountain goats bring forth their young, and do you keep watch while the hinds are in labor?
Can you reckon the months they carry to term, and are you aware of the hour of their delivery?
They crouch down to calve, they bring forth their offspring, and they cast off their birth pangs.
Their young grow robust and flourish in the open country; they go forth and never return to them. “
Who has granted liberty to the wild donkey, and who has loosed the ropes that held it?
I have appointed the wasteland as its dwelling and the salt flats as its habitation.
It mocks the uproar of the city and is deaf to the driver's shout.
It roams the mountain ranges in search of pasture and seeks out every green blade. “
Will the wild ox consent to be your servant, or will it lodge by your manger through the night?
Can you bind it to the furrow with a tether, or will it plow the valleys in your wake?
Will you rely upon it for its prodigious strength, and entrust your heavy labor to it?
Can you trust it to bring home your seed and gather the harvest to your threshing floor? “
The ostrich's wings beat exultantly, but are they the pinions and plumage of the stork?
For she abandons her eggs to the earth and lets them be warmed in the dust,
forgetful that a foot may crush them or that a beast of the field may trample them.
She is harsh toward her young, as though they were not her own; her labor is for naught, and she is without fear,
because God has deprived her of wisdom and has not imparted understanding to her.
Yet when she rouses herself to flee, she mocks horse and rider. “
Do you impart strength to the horse, or clothe its neck with a flowing mane?
Do you make it bound like a locust, so that the majesty of its snorting inspires terror?
It paws violently in the valley and exults in its might; it charges forth to meet the clash of arms.
It scoffs at terror and is not daunted; it does not recoil before the sword.
The quiver rattles against it, along with the gleaming spear and javelin.
With quaking and fury it devours the ground, nor can it believe that the sound is merely the trumpet.
At every trumpet blast it snorts, 'Aha!' and from afar it scents the battle—the thunder of commanders and the war cry. “
Does the hawk take wing by your wisdom, spreading its pinions toward the south?
Does the eagle soar at your bidding and build its nest on high?
It inhabits the cliff and spends the night there; the rocky crag is its fortress.
From there it spies out prey, and its eyes discern it from afar.
Its fledglings drink in blood, and wherever the slain lie, there it is.”
Then the LORD answered Job, saying:
"Shall one who contends with the Almighty presume to correct Him? Let him who reproves God answer."
Then Job answered the LORD and said:
"Behold, I am of no account; what reply can I make to You? I have laid my hand upon my mouth.
I have spoken once, and I will not answer again; twice, yet I will add nothing further."
Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind and said:
"Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer Me.
Will you indeed nullify My judgment? Will you condemn Me so that you may be vindicated?
Have you an arm comparable to God’s? Can you thunder with a voice like His?
Adorn yourself with majesty and exaltation; clothe yourself with glory and splendor.
Unleash the torrents of your wrath; look upon every proud man and abase him.
Regard every proud man and bring him low; trample the wicked in their place.
Bury them all in the dust; imprison them in the grave.
Then I too will acknowledge you, for your own right hand can save you."
"Behold now Behemoth, whom I made along with you; he feeds on grass like an ox.
Behold, his vigor resides in his loins, and his power in the muscles of his belly.
He makes his tail rigid like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are interwoven.
His bones are like tubes of bronze; his limbs resemble bars of iron.
He is the preeminent work of God; only his Maker can draw near him with a sword.
The mountains yield him their produce, and all the beasts of the field disport themselves there.
He reclines under the lotus plants, in the covert of the reeds and in the marsh.
The lotus plants shade him with their shadow; the willows of the brook encircle him.
Though the river be turbulent, he is not dismayed; he remains secure, even should the Jordan surge against his mouth.
Can anyone seize him while he keeps watch, or pierce his nose with a snare?"
Can you draw Leviathan forth with a hook, or with a cord weigh down his tongue?
Can you thread a rush through his nostril, or bore his jaw with a thorn?
Will he lavish you with supplications, or address you in blandishments?
Will he strike a covenant with you, that you might claim him as a perpetual bondservant? “
Can you sport with him as with a bird, or bind him for your maidens?
Will traders haggle over him, or partition him among merchants?
Can you fill his hide with harpoons, or his head with fishing spears?
Lay your hand upon him; you will remember the battle and never renew the attempt.
Behold, his expectation is deceived; at the mere sight of him one is overwhelmed. “
No one is so ferocious as to rouse him; who then could stand before Me?
Who has given to Me that I should repay him? Everything under heaven is Mine. “
I will not keep silent concerning his limbs, nor the report of his might and the grace of his frame.
Who has uncovered the face of his raiment? Who can approach him within the fold of his bridle?
Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.
His back is rows of shields, shut up as with a close seal.
One approaches another so closely that no breath passes between them.
They are joined to one another; they clasp and will not be separated. “
His snorts flash forth light, and his eyes are like the eyelids of dawn.
Firebrands stream from his mouth; sparks of fire escape.
Smoke billows from his nostrils, as from a seething pot over burning reeds.
His breath kindles coals, and a flame pours from his mouth.
Strength lodges in his neck, and dismay leaps before him.
The folds of his flesh cleave together; they are firm upon him and immovable.
His heart is as hard as stone, even as hard as a lower millstone. “
When he raises himself up, the mighty are terrified; they recoil before his thrashings.
The sword that reaches him avails nothing, nor the spear, dart, or javelin.
He reckons iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.
The bow will not make him flee; slingstones are to him as chaff.
A club is counted as stubble, and he laughs at the rattling of the spear. “
Beneath him are sharp potsherds; he spreads a threshing sledge upon the mire.
He makes the deep boil like a pot; he makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
He leaves a luminous wake behind him; one would think the deep had grown hoary.
On earth there is nothing like him, a creature made without fear.
He looks down upon all that is lofty; he is king over all the sons of pride.”
Then Job answered the LORD and said:
“I know that You can do all things, and that no purpose of Yours can be thwarted.
Who is this that obscures counsel without knowledge? Therefore I have uttered what I did not understand—things too wonderful for me, which I did not know.
Hear, I pray, and I will speak; I will question You, and You make it known to me.
I had heard of You by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees You.
Therefore I despise myself and repent in dust and ashes.”

After the LORD had spoken these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite: “My anger is kindled against you and against your two friends, for you have not spoken of Me what is right, as My servant Job has.

Now therefore take seven bulls and seven rams, and go to My servant Job and offer up a burnt offering for yourselves; and My servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept his prayer not to deal with you according to your folly, because you have not spoken of Me what is right, as My servant Job has.”
So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as the LORD had told them, and the LORD accepted Job's prayer.
And the LORD restored the fortunes of Job when he had prayed for his friends. And the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

Then all his brothers and all his sisters and all who had known him before came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They showed him sympathy and comforted him for all the adversity that the LORD had brought upon him. And each gave him a piece of money and a gold ring.
And the LORD blessed the latter days of Job more than his beginning, and he had 14,000 sheep, 6,000 camels, 1,000 yoke of oxen, and 1,000 female donkeys.
He had also seven sons and three daughters.
He called the name of the first Jemimah, and the name of the second Keziah, and the name of the third Keren-happuch.
In all the land there were no women so beautiful as Job's daughters, and their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
After this Job lived 140 years, and saw his sons and his sons' sons, four generations.
Then Job died, being old and full of days.
How blessed is the man who does not follow the counsel of the wicked, nor take his stand among sinners, nor settle into the company of scoffers;
but whose delight resides in the law of the the LORD, and who meditates upon His law day and night.
He shall be like a tree transplanted beside streams of water, yielding its fruit in its season, its leaf never withering, and in all that he undertakes he prospers.
The wicked are not so; rather, they are like chaff that the wind drives away.
Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous;
for the the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
Why do the nations tumultuously assemble, and why do the peoples devise emptiness?
The kings of the earth take their stand, and the rulers take counsel together against the LORD and against His Anointed, saying,
“Let us shatter their fetters and hurl their cords away from us.”
He who is enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord derides them.
Then He addresses them in His wrath and terrifies them in His burning anger, saying,
“Yet I have installed My King upon Zion, My holy mountain.”
I will proclaim the decree: the LORD said to me, “You are My Son; today I have begotten you.
Ask of Me, and I will give the nations as Your inheritance and the ends of the earth as Your possession.
You shall shatter them with an iron rod; you shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
Now therefore, exercise prudence, O kings; receive correction, O judges of the earth.
Serve the LORD with reverent awe, and rejoice with trembling.
Do homage to the Son, lest He be incensed and you perish along the way, for His wrath flares up in an instant. Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.
The LORD, how my adversaries have multiplied! Many rise up against me.
Many are declaring concerning me, “There is no salvation for him in God.” Selah.
But You, the LORD, are a shield encircling me—my glory and the One who exalts me.
I cry aloud to the LORD, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah.
I lay down and slept; I awoke, for the LORD sustains me.
I will not dread myriads of people who have arrayed themselves against me round about.
Arise, the LORD! Deliver me, my God! For You have smitten all my enemies upon the cheek; You have shattered the teeth of the wicked.
Salvation belongs to the LORD; Your blessing be upon Your people. Selah.
For the choirmaster, with stringed instruments—a Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness; You have granted me relief in adversity. Be gracious to me and hear my prayer.
How long, O sons of men, will you transmute my honor into disgrace? How long will you cleave to emptiness and pursue falsehood? Selah.
But know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.
Tremble, yet sin not; commune within your heart upon your bed, and be silent. Selah.
Offer sacrifices of righteousness, and trust in the LORD.
Many are saying, "Who will show us good? Let the light of Your face shine upon us, O the LORD."
You have put gladness in my heart, more than in the season when their grain and new wine abound.
In peace I will both lie down and sleep, for You alone, O the LORD, make me dwell in safety.
Listen to my words, the LORD; consider my inward meditation.
Attend to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.
In the morning, the LORD, You hear my voice; at dawn I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.
For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.
The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.
You destroy those who speak lies; the LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and the deceitful.
But as for me, by Your great loving devotion I will enter Your house; in reverence for You I will bow down toward Your holy temple.
Lead me, the LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make Your way straight before me.
For there is no truth in their mouths; their inward parts are bent on destruction; their throats are open graves; they flatter with their tongues.
Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.
But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy, because You shelter them; and let those who love Your name exult in You.
For You, the LORD, bless the righteous; You surround him with favor as with a shield.
To the choirmaster, with stringed instruments, upon the octave—a psalm of David. the LORD, do not reprove me in Your indignation, nor chasten me in Your fury.
Be gracious to me, the LORD, for I am languishing; heal me, the LORD, for my bones are convulsed with anguish.
My soul is likewise seized with profound terror; but You, the LORD—how long?
Return, the LORD, and rescue my life; deliver me for the sake of Your loving devotion.
For in death there is no remembrance of You; who can give You thanks from Sheol?
I have grown weary with my groaning; every night I flood my bed with tears, and I drench my couch with weeping.
My eye has grown dim with sorrow; it has wasted away because of all my adversaries.
Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.
The LORD has heard my supplication; the LORD receives my prayer.
All my enemies shall be put to shame and sorely dismayed; they shall turn back and be confounded in a moment.
The LORD my God, in You I have taken refuge; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers.
Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it apart, with no one to deliver.
The LORD my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
if I have repaid my ally with evil, or plundered my adversary without cause,
then let the enemy pursue and overtake my soul, trample my life to the ground, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.
Arise, the LORD, in Your anger; lift Yourself up against the fury of my adversaries, and awake for me the judgment You have commanded.
Let the congregation of the peoples surround You; return, then, and take Your seat above them.
The LORD judges the peoples; judge me, the LORD, according to my righteousness and according to my integrity.
Let the evil of the wicked come to an end, and establish the righteous—O righteous God, who tests hearts and minds.
My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
God is a righteous judge, a God who is indignant every day.
If he does not repent, He will whet His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.
He has prepared for him the instruments of death; He fashions His arrows against the pursuers.
Behold, he travails with iniquity, conceives mischief, and gives birth to falsehood.
He has dug a pit and hollowed it out, and has fallen into the hole he made.
His toil shall return upon his own head, and his violence shall descend upon his crown.
I will give thanks to the LORD according to His righteousness, and I will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
O the LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.
From the mouths of infants and nursing children You have established strength, because of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and the avenger.
When I contemplate Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars that You have set in place,
what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You attend to him?
Yet You have made him a little lower than the heavenly beings and crowned him with glory and honor.
You have given him dominion over the works of Your hands; You have put all things under his feet:
all sheep and oxen, and also the beasts of the field,
the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, all that traverse the paths of the seas.
O the LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
I shall render thanksgiving unto the LORD with the totality of my heart; I shall recount all Your prodigious deeds.
I shall exult and be jubilant in You; I shall chant praise unto Your name, O Most High.
When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.
For You have vindicated my right and my cause; You sit enthroned as righteous Judge.
You have rebuked the nations; You have annihilated the wicked; You have effaced their name forever and ever.
The enemy is brought to utter ruin—perpetual desolations; You have uprooted their cities, and even their remembrance has perished.
But the LORD sits enthroned forever; He has established His throne for judgment.
He judges the world in righteousness; He renders judgment upon the peoples with equity.
The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of distress.
Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O the LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.
Sing praises to the LORD, enthroned in Zion; proclaim among the peoples His deeds.
For He who avenges bloodshed remembers them; He does not forget the cry of the afflicted.
Be gracious to me, O the LORD; behold my affliction from those who hate me, You who lift me up from the gates of death.
That I may declare all Your praise in the gates of the Daughter of Zion, I shall rejoice in Your salvation.
The nations have sunk into the pit they made; their foot is caught in the net they concealed.
The LORD has made Himself known; He has executed judgment; the wicked are snared by the work of their own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
The wicked shall return to Sheol—all the nations that forget God.
For the needy shall not be forgotten forever, nor shall the hope of the afflicted perish in perpetuity.
Arise, O the LORD; let not man prevail; let the nations be judged before You.
Strike them with terror, O the LORD; let the nations know that they are but men. Selah.
Why, O the LORD, do You stand so aloof, and why do You hide Yourself in the hour of affliction?
Through the arrogance of the wicked, the afflicted are relentlessly pursued, and they are caught in the plots those evildoers have devised.
For the wicked exults in the cravings of his soul; he applauds the greedy and reviles the the LORD.
In the haughtiness of his countenance the wicked does not seek God; all his thoughts are, “There is no God.”
His ways prosper at every turn; Your judgments are exalted beyond his ken; he sneers at all his adversaries.
He says in his heart, “I shall never be shaken; throughout the generations I shall know no calamity.”
His mouth is brimming with cursing, deceit, and oppression; beneath his tongue lurk mischief and iniquity.
He lurks in the hiding places of the villages; in secret he slays the innocent; his eyes are ever on the watch for the helpless.
He lurks in his covert like a lion in his thicket; he lurks to snatch away the afflicted; he seizes the afflicted as he drags them into his net.
The helpless are crushed and brought low; they fall by his might.
He says in his heart, “God has forgotten; He has hidden His face; He will never behold it.”
Arise, O the LORD; O God, lift up Your hand; do not forget the afflicted.
Why does the wicked revile God, saying in his heart, “You will not call it to account”?
Yet You have seen, for You behold trouble and grief, to take it into Your hand. The helpless entrusts himself to You; You have been the helper of the fatherless.
Shatter the might of the wicked and the evildoer; search out his wickedness until You find none.
The the LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.
O the LORD, You have heard the desire of the afflicted; You strengthen their hearts; You incline Your ear to render justice to the fatherless and the oppressed, that mortal man may terrify no more.
In the LORD I have taken refuge. How, then, can you say to my soul, “Flee like a bird to your mountain?
For behold, the wicked bend the bow; they have set their arrow upon the string to shoot from the darkness at the upright in heart.
If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous accomplish?”
The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD’s throne is in heaven. His eyes behold; His eyelids examine the sons of men.
The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked; His soul hates the lover of violence.
Upon the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur; a scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright shall behold His face.
Deliver us, O the LORD, for the pious have vanished; indeed, the faithful have disappeared from among the sons of men.
They speak emptiness to one another; with flattering lips and divided hearts they converse.
May the LORD cut off all flattering lips and every tongue that utters grandiose claims.
These are the ones who declare, “By our tongues we shall prevail; our lips are our own—who can be lord over us?”
“Because of the devastation of the poor and the groaning of the needy, now I will arise,” says the LORD. “I will establish in safety the one who yearns for it.”
The utterances of the LORD are altogether pure—silver refined in an earthen crucible and purified sevenfold.
You, O the LORD, will keep them; You will guard him forever from this generation.
The wicked strut about on every side while depravity is exalted among the sons of men.
To the choirmaster: a psalm of David. How long, O the LORD, will You consign me to oblivion? How long will You veil Your countenance from me?
How long must I deliberate within my soul, bearing grief in my heart throughout the day? How long shall my adversary exalt himself above me?
Regard and respond to me, O the LORD my God; illumine my eyes, lest I succumb to the slumber of death,
lest my foe proclaim, “I have prevailed against him,” and my adversaries exult because I have faltered.
Yet I have trusted in Your steadfast love; my heart shall exult in Your deliverance.
I shall sing unto the LORD, for He has dealt munificently with me.
The benighted fool declares within his heart, “There is no God.” They have corrupted themselves and perpetrated abominations; not one among them practices goodness.
From heaven the LORD surveys the children of Adam to discern whether any possess understanding, whether any seek after God.
They have all turned aside and become uniformly corrupt; there is none who does good—not even one.
Do all these workers of iniquity lack understanding? They devour my people as if consuming bread, and they do not invoke the LORD.
There they are, seized with overwhelming dread, for God dwells among the generation of the righteous.
You evildoers would put the counsel of the poor to shame, yet the LORD is their refuge.
O that Israel’s salvation might issue forth from Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of His people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad.
A psalm of David. The LORD, who may sojourn in Your tent, and who may abide upon Your holy mountain?
The one who walks in integrity and practices righteousness, and who speaks truth from the heart.
He does not slander with his tongue, nor does he do evil to his neighbor, nor does he take up a reproach against his friend.
In his eyes a vile person is despised, yet he honors those who fear the LORD; he keeps his oath even when it costs him dearly.
He does not lend his money at interest, nor does he accept a bribe against the innocent. The one who does these things shall never be shaken.
Preserve me, O God, for in You I have sought refuge.
I have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; I possess no good apart from You.”
As for the saints in the land, they are the noble ones in whom all my delight resides.
The sorrows of those who hasten after another god shall multiply; I will not pour out their bloody libations, nor will I invoke their names upon my lips.
The LORD is my portion and my cup; You uphold my lot.
The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; indeed, my inheritance is exceedingly delightful.
I will bless the LORD, who counsels me; even in the night my conscience instructs me.
I have set the LORD continually before me; because He is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Therefore my heart rejoices, my whole being exults, and my flesh rests secure.
For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You allow Your Holy One to see corruption.
You will show me the path of life; in Your presence there is fullness of joy; at Your right hand are pleasures forevermore.
Hear, the LORD, my righteous plea; attend to my cry, and give ear to my prayer, uttered by lips untainted by deceit.
Let my vindication proceed from Your presence; let Your eyes discern what is upright.
You have probed my heart; You have visited me in the night; You have refined me and found no iniquity within me; I have resolved that my mouth shall not transgress.
As for the deeds of mortals, by the word of Your lips I have shunned the paths of the violent.
My steps have held fast to Your courses; my feet have not faltered.
I call upon You, O God, for You will answer me; incline Your ear to me and hear my prayer.
Show forth the wonders of Your steadfast love, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their adversaries.
Keep me as the apple of Your eye; conceal me in the shadow of Your wings.
from the wicked who despoil me, from my mortal enemies who encircle me.
Their hearts have grown callous; their mouths utter arrogance.
They have tracked me down; they now surround me; their eyes are set to cast me to the ground.
Like a lion he longs to tear his prey, like a young lion lurking in ambush.
Arise, the LORD; confront them and bring them to their knees; deliver my soul from the wicked by Your sword.

from mortals, the LORD, by Your hand—from men of this world whose portion is in this life. May You fill their bellies with Your treasure; may their sons have abundance, and may they leave their surplus to their children.
As for me, I shall behold Your face in righteousness; when I awake, I shall be satisfied with Your presence.

To the choirmaster: a psalm of David, the servant of the the LORD, who spoke to the the LORD the words of this song on the day when the the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. And he said, "I love You, the the LORD, my strength.
The The LORD is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
I call upon the the LORD, who is worthy to be praised, and I am saved from my enemies. "
The cords of death encompassed me, and the torrents of destruction terrified me.
The cords of Sheol surrounded me; the snares of death confronted me. "
In my distress I called upon the the LORD; to my God I cried for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry came before Him, into His ears. "
Then the earth reeled and rocked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled and quaked, because He was angry.
Smoke went up from His nostrils, and devouring fire from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth from Him.
He bowed the heavens and came down, with thick darkness under His feet.
He rode on a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
He made darkness His covering; His canopy around Him was dark waters and thick clouds of the skies. "
Out of the brightness before Him His thick clouds passed, with hailstones and coals of fire.
The The LORD thundered in the heavens, and the Most High uttered His voice, with hailstones and coals of fire.
He sent out His arrows and scattered them; He flashed forth lightnings and routed them.
Then the channels of the sea were seen, and the foundations of the world were laid bare, at Your rebuke, the the LORD, at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils. "
He reached down from on high and took me; He drew me out of many waters.
He rescued me from my strong enemy, and from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
They confronted me in the day of my calamity, but the the LORD was my support.
He brought me out into a broad place; He rescued me, because He delighted in me. "
The The LORD has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands He has recompensed me.
For I have kept the ways of the the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
For all His judgments were before me, and His statutes I did not put away from me.
I was blameless before Him, and I kept myself from my iniquity.
So the the LORD has recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight. "
With the faithful You show Yourself faithful; with the blameless You show Yourself blameless.
With the pure You show Yourself pure, and with the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
For You save an afflicted people, but the haughty eyes You bring down.
For You light my lamp; the the LORD my God illumines my darkness.
For by You I can run against a troop; by my God I can leap over a wall.
As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the the LORD is refined; He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him. "
For who is God but the the LORD? And who is a rock except our God?
It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way blameless.
He makes my feet like the feet of a deer and sets me secure on the heights.
He trains my hands for war, so that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
You have given me the shield of Your salvation, and Your right hand has supported me, and Your gentleness has made me great.
You enlarge my steps beneath me, so that my feet do not slip. "
I pursued my enemies and overtook them, and did not turn back until they were consumed.
I struck them down, so that they were not able to rise; they fell beneath my feet.
For You girded me with strength for the battle; You made those who rose against me sink under me.
You made my enemies turn their backs to me, and those who hated me I destroyed.
They cried for help, but there was none to save; they cried to the the LORD, but He did not answer them.
I beat them as fine as dust before the wind; I cast them out like mud in the streets. "
You delivered me from strife with the people; You made me the head of the nations; a people I had not known served me.
As soon as they heard of me, they obeyed me; foreigners cringed before me.
Foreigners lost heart and came trembling out of their fortresses. "
The The LORD lives, and blessed be my rock, and exalted be the God of my salvation.
The God who gives me vengeance and subdues peoples under me.
He delivers me from my enemies; indeed, You exalt me above those who rise against me; You rescue me from the violent man.
Therefore I will give thanks to You among the nations, the the LORD, and sing praises to Your name.
Great salvation He gives to His king, and shows steadfast love to His Anointed, to David and his offspring forever."
The heavens recount the glory of God, and the expanse proclaims the work of His hands.
Day after day they pour forth speech, and night after night they disclose knowledge.
There is no speech, there are no words; their voice is unheard.
Yet their sound has gone out through all the earth, and their utterances to the end of the world. In them He has pitched a tent for the sun.
And it is like a bridegroom coming forth from his chamber; it rejoices like a mighty man to run its course.
Its rising is from one end of the heavens, and its circuit reaches the other; and nothing is hidden from its heat.
The law of the LORD is perfect, restoring the soul; the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
The precepts of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart; the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true and altogether righteous.
More to be desired are they than gold, even than much fine gold; sweeter also than honey and the drippings of the honeycomb.
Moreover, by them Your servant is warned; in keeping them there is great reward.
Who can discern his own errors? Acquit me of hidden faults.
Restrain Your servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me. Then I shall be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in Your sight, O the LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
May the LORD respond to you in the day of affliction; may the renown of the God of Jacob establish you securely.
May He dispatch succor to you from the sanctuary, and uphold you from Zion.
May He remember all your grain offerings, and regard your burnt offerings with favor. Selah.
May He bestow upon you the longing of your heart, and bring all your plans to fruition.
May we exult in your deliverance, and raise our banners in the name of our God. May the LORD satisfy all your petitions.
Now I am assured that the LORD delivers His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven by the triumphant might of His right hand.
Some place their confidence in chariots and others in horses, but we invoke the name of the LORD our God.
They stumble and are laid low, whereas we arise and remain steadfast.
The LORD, save the king! Answer us when we call.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O the LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength; how greatly he exults in Your salvation!
You have granted him the desire of his heart and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.
He asked You for life, and You gave it to him—length of days, forever and ever.
Great is his glory through Your salvation; splendor and majesty You have bestowed on him.
For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.
For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.
Your hand will seize all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.
You will make them like a fiery furnace in the time of Your anger. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and fire will consume them.
You will wipe out their descendants from the earth and their offspring from the sons of men.
Though they intend evil against You and devise a plot, they will not succeed.
For You will put them to flight; You will aim Your bow at their faces.
Be exalted, O the LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so remote from my deliverance, and from heeding the words of my anguished cry?
O my God, I cry out by day, yet You do not answer; by night, I find no repose.
Yet You are holy, enthroned upon the praises of Israel.
In You our fathers trusted; they trusted, and You delivered them.
They cried to You and were saved; they trusted in You and were not put to shame.
But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.
All who behold me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads.
“He trusts in the the LORD; let the the LORD deliver him; let the the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him.”
Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me trust in You, even at my mother’s breast.
From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.
Do not be far from me, for trouble is near, and there is no one to help.
Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
They open their mouths against me like roaring, mauling lions.
I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint; my heart has turned to wax and melted within me.
My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue cleaves to the roof of my mouth; You lay me in the dust of death.
For dogs surround me; a company of evildoers encircles me; they have pierced my hands and my feet.
I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.
They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.
But You, O the the LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.
Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me.
I will declare Your name to my brothers; in the midst of the assembly I will praise You.
You who fear the the LORD, praise Him! All you descendants of Jacob, honor Him! All you descendants of Israel, revere Him!
For He has not despised or detested the affliction of the afflicted; He has not hidden His face from him, but when he cried to Him, He heard.
From You comes my praise in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.
The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the the LORD; all the families of the nations will bow down before You.
For dominion belongs to the the LORD, and He rules over the nations.
All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him—those who cannot preserve their lives.
Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to the next generation.
They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn—all that He has done.
A psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
He makes me lie down in verdant pastures; He leads me beside tranquil waters.
He restores my soul; He guides me along righteous paths for His name's sake.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
Surely goodness and mercy shall pursue me all the days of my life, and I shall dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
A psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’s, together with all that fills it; the world and all who dwell within it are His.
For He founded it upon the seas and established it upon the rivers.
Who shall ascend the mountain of the LORD, and who shall stand in His holy place?
The one whose hands are clean and whose heart is pure, who has not devoted his soul to vanity, and who has not sworn deceitfully.
He shall receive blessing from the LORD and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O Jacob. Selah.
Lift up your heads, O gates, and be lifted up, O everlasting doors, that the King of Glory may come in.
Who is this King of Glory? The LORD, strong and mighty; the LORD, mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, O gates; lift them up, O everlasting doors, that the King of Glory may come in.
Who is this King of Glory? The LORD of hosts—He is the King of Glory. Selah.
Unto You, O the LORD, do I lift up my very soul.
In You, O my God, have I reposed my trust; let me not be brought to shame, neither let my adversaries exult triumphantly over me.
Yea, none who wait upon You shall suffer disgrace; but those who practice perfidy without provocation shall be put to shame.
Make known to me Your ways, O the LORD, and instruct me in Your paths.
Lead me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; the whole day long I wait upon You.
Remember, O the LORD, Your tender mercies and Your steadfast love, for they are from everlasting.
Remember not the transgressions of my youth, nor my rebellious deeds; according to Your steadfast love remember me, for the sake of Your goodness, O the LORD.
The The LORD is good and upright; therefore He instructs sinners in the way.
He guides the meek in judgment and teaches the meek His way.
All the paths of the the LORD are steadfast love and faithfulness to those who keep His covenant and His testimonies.
For Your name’s sake, O the LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
Who, then, is the man that fears the the LORD? Him will He instruct in the way he should choose.
His soul shall dwell in prosperity, and his offspring shall inherit the land.
The The LORD takes into His confidence those who fear Him, and makes known to them His covenant.
My eyes are ever toward the the LORD, for He shall pluck my feet out of the net.
Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am solitary and afflicted.
The distresses of my heart are enlarged; bring me forth out of my straits.
Consider my affliction and my toil, and forgive all my sins.
Behold how numerous are my enemies, and with cruel hatred they detest me.
Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I have taken refuge in You.
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.
Redeem Israel, O God, from all its troubles.
Vindicate me, O the LORD, for I have conducted myself in integrity; I have trusted in the LORD, and I shall not waver.
Examine me, O the LORD, and put me to the proof; refine my inmost being and my heart.
For Your lovingkindness stands before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.
I have not sat with men of falsehood, nor shall I consort with dissemblers.
I have hated the assembly of evildoers, and I will not sit with the wicked.
I cleanse my hands in innocence, and I make my circuit about Your altar, O the LORD, that I may proclaim with the voice of thanksgiving, and recount all Your wondrous deeds.
O the LORD, I have loved the dwelling of Your house, and the place where Your glory abides.
Do not gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with men of blood,
in whose hands is depravity, and whose right hand is full of bribes.
But as for me, I will walk in my integrity; redeem me, and be gracious to me.
My foot stands upon an even plain; in the great assemblies I will bless the LORD.
The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom, then, shall I fear? The LORD is the bulwark of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
When malefactors draw near to devour my flesh—my adversaries and foes—they stumble and fall.
Though a host encamp against me, my heart shall not fear; though war be raised against me, in this I put my trust.
One thing I have asked of the LORD, and that I will seek: that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD and to inquire in His sanctuary.
For in the day of trouble He will conceal me in His shelter; in the covert of His tent He will hide me; He will set me high upon a rock.
And now my head shall be lifted up above my enemies round about me; and in His tent I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make melody to the LORD.
Hear, O LORD, when I cry aloud; be gracious to me and answer me.
You have said, "Seek My face." My heart says to you, "Your face, O LORD, do I seek."
Hide not Your face from me; turn not Your servant away in anger, You who have been my help. Cast me not off, nor forsake me, O God of my salvation.
For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but the LORD will receive me.
Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path because of my enemies.
Give me not up to the will of my adversaries; for false witnesses have risen against me, and they breathe out violence.
I should have despaired, had I not believed that I would behold the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
Wait for the LORD; be strong, and let your heart take courage; yes, wait for the LORD.
Unto You, the LORD, I cry aloud; be not deaf unto me, O my Rock, lest, should You remain silent toward me, I be reckoned among those who descend into the pit.
Hear the voice of my supplications when I cry out unto You, when I elevate my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
Do not draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice resides in their hearts.
Deal with them according to their deeds and according to the wickedness of their endeavors; repay them according to the work of their hands; render unto them their due.
For they do not regard the works of the LORD, nor the operation of His hands; He shall tear them down and shall not rebuild them.
Blessed be the LORD, for He has heard the voice of my supplications.
The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart has trusted in Him, and I was helped; therefore my heart exults, and with my song I will praise Him.
The LORD is strength unto them, and He is the saving stronghold of His anointed.
Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and bear them up forever.
Attribute to the LORD, O sons of God, attribute to the LORD glory and might.
Attribute to the LORD the glory due His name; bow before the LORD in the splendor of holiness.
The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is over many waters.
The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
The voice of the LORD shatters the cedars; indeed, the LORD splinters the cedars of Lebanon.
He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
The voice of the LORD hews forth flames of fire.
The voice of the LORD convulses the wilderness; the LORD convulses the wilderness of Kadesh.
The voice of the LORD brings the deer to labor and lays the forests bare; and in His temple all proclaim, "Glory!"
The LORD sat enthroned over the flood; the LORD sits as King forever.
The LORD imparts strength to His people; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the House. Of David. I will exalt You, O the LORD, for You have lifted me up, and have not allowed my enemies to rejoice over me.
O the LORD my God, unto You I cried, and You healed me.
O the LORD, You brought my soul up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
Sing unto the LORD, O His saints, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness.
For His anger endures but a moment, whereas His favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may tarry through the evening, but joy arrives in the morning.
In my prosperity I said, "I shall never be moved."
O the LORD, by Your favor You established my mountain as a stronghold; You hid Your face, and I was dismayed.
Unto You, O the LORD, I cry; to the Lord I make supplication.
What profit is there in my blood, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
Hear, O the LORD, and be gracious to me; O the LORD, be my helper.
You have turned my mourning into dancing; You have loosed my sackcloth and girded me with gladness,
so that my glory may sing praise to You and not be silent. O the LORD my God, I will give thanks to You forever.
In You, the LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; deliver me in Your righteousness.
Incline Your ear to me; rescue me swiftly. Be my rock of refuge, a fortified stronghold to save me.
For You are my rock and my fortress; for the sake of Your name, lead and guide me.
Free me from the snare they have hidden for me, for You are my refuge.
Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, the LORD, God of truth.
I abhor those who cling to worthless idols, but as for me, I trust in the LORD.
I will exult and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction and You have known the anguish of my soul.
You have not surrendered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in a spacious place.
Be gracious to me, the LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes grow dim with sorrow, and my soul and body with grief.
For my life is consumed with anguish and my years with groaning; my strength falters because of my iniquity, and my bones waste away.
Because of all my adversaries I have become a reproach—especially to my neighbors—and an object of dread to my acquaintances; those who see me in the street flee from me.
I am forgotten as though dead; I have become like a shattered vessel.
For I hear the whispering of many—“Terror on every side!”—as they conspire together against me and plot to take my life.
But I trust in You, the LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
My times are in Your hands; deliver me from the hand of my enemies and from my pursuers.
Let Your face shine upon Your servant; save me in Your steadfast love.
The LORD, let me not be put to shame, for I call upon You; let the wicked be put to shame and be silenced in Sheol.
Let lying lips be silenced—those that speak arrogantly against the righteous with pride and contempt.
How abundant is Your goodness, which You have treasured up for those who fear You and lavished before the children of men upon those who take refuge in You!
You hide them in the shelter of Your presence from the plots of man; You shelter them in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me the wonders of His steadfast love in a besieged city.
In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight.” Yet You heard the voice of my supplications when I cried to You for help.
Love the LORD, all His faithful ones! The LORD preserves the faithful, but to the proud He repays in full.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
How blessed is the one whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered!
How blessed is the person to whom the LORD does not reckon iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile!
When I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
For day and night Your hand lay heavy upon me; my vitality was turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
I acknowledged my sin to You, and I did not conceal my iniquity; I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
Therefore let every godly person pray to You while You may be found; surely, when the great waters surge, they will not overwhelm him.
You are my hiding place; You preserve me from distress; You surround me with shouts of deliverance. Selah.
“I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with My eye upon you.
Do not be like the horse or the mule, which lack understanding, whose mouth must be controlled with bit and bridle, or they will not come near you.”
Many are the afflictions of the wicked, but steadfast love encompasses the one who trusts in the LORD.
Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, you righteous, and shout for joy, all you upright in heart!
Exult in the LORD, O righteous; praise is comely for the upright.
Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre; make melody to Him with the ten-stringed harp.
Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of triumph.
For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is done in faithfulness.
He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the LORD's steadfast love.
By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and by the breath of His mouth all their host.
He gathers the waters of the sea as a heap; He puts the deeps in storehouses.
Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.
For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.
The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing; He frustrates the thoughts of the peoples.
The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the thoughts of His heart to all generations.
Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His heritage.
The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the children of man.
From His dwelling place He looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth—
He who fashions the hearts of them all and observes all their deeds.
The king is not saved by his great army; a warrior is not delivered by his great strength.
The horse is a false hope for safety, and by its great might it cannot rescue.
Behold, the eye of the LORD is on those who fear Him, on those who hope in His steadfast love,
that He may deliver their souls from death and keep them alive in famine.
Our souls wait for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
For our hearts rejoice in Him, because we trust in His holy name.
Let Your steadfast love, O the LORD, be upon us, as we hope in You.
I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
My soul shall exult in the LORD; let the humble hear and rejoice.
Oh, magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt His name together!
I sought the LORD, and He answered me and delivered me from all my fears.
Those who look to Him are radiant, and their faces shall never be put to shame.
This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him and saved him from all his troubles.
The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and rescues them.
Oh, taste and see that the LORD is good! Blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
Fear the LORD, you His saints, for there is no lack for those who fear Him.
Young lions suffer want and hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.
Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
What man is there who desires life and loves to see good days?
Guard your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
The eyes of the LORD are toward the righteous, and His ears toward their cry.
The face of the LORD is against evildoers, to cut off their remembrance from the earth.
When the righteous cry out, the LORD hears them and delivers them from all their troubles.
The LORD is near to the brokenhearted and saves those crushed in spirit.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
He guards all his bones; not one of them is broken.
Evil shall slay the wicked, and those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
The LORD redeems the life of His servants; none of those who take refuge in Him shall be condemned.
May the LORD contend with those who contend with me; may He fight against those who fight against me.
Take hold of shield and buckler, and rise to my aid.
Draw out the spear and bar the way against my pursuers; say to my soul, “I am your salvation.”
Let those who seek my life be confounded and disgraced; let those who devise evil against me be repelled and humiliated.
Let them be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the LORD driving them on.
May their path be dark and treacherous, while the angel of the LORD pursues them.
For without provocation they concealed their net for me; without provocation they dug a pit for my life.
Let ruin overtake him unawares; let the net he concealed ensnare him; let him fall into that very ruin.
Then my soul shall exult in the LORD and rejoice in His salvation.
All my bones shall declare, “Who is like You, the LORD, delivering the poor from the one too strong for him, and the poor and needy from their plunderer?”
Ruthless witnesses rise up; they interrogate me concerning things I do not know.
They repay me evil for good, seeking the bereavement of my soul.
Yet when they were ill, I clothed myself in sackcloth; I afflicted my soul with fasting, and my prayer returned to me unanswered.
I went about as though for a friend or brother; I bowed down in grief as one mourning for a mother.
Yet when I stumbled, they rejoiced and assembled; attackers gathered against me without my knowledge; they slandered me without ceasing.
Like profane mockers at a banquet, they gnashed their teeth at me.
How long, O Lord, will You look on? Deliver my soul from their desolations, my precious life from the lions.
I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among a mighty throng.
Let not my enemies rejoice over me wrongfully, nor let those who hate me without cause wink maliciously.
For they do not speak peaceably; they devise deceitful plots against the tranquil in the land.
They gaped at me and cried, “Aha! Aha! Our eyes have seen it.”
The LORD, You have seen; do not be silent. O Lord, do not be far from me.
Rouse Yourself and awake to my vindication, to my cause, my God and my Lord.
Judge me, the LORD my God, according to Your righteousness, and let them not exult over me.
Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha! This is what we desired.” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up.”
Let those who rejoice at my calamity be ashamed and confounded together; let those who magnify themselves against me be clothed with shame and dishonor.
Let those who delight in my vindication shout for joy and be glad; let them say continually, “The LORD be magnified, who delights in the well-being of His servant.”
Then my tongue shall recount Your righteousness and Your praise all the day long.
An oracle resounds within my heart concerning the transgression of the wicked: there is no fear of God before his eyes.
For in his own estimation he flatters himself so thoroughly that he cannot discover his iniquity, much less abhor it.
The utterances of his mouth are mischief and deceit; he has abandoned wisdom and the practice of good.
Upon his bed he devises iniquity; he stations himself upon a path that is not good; he does not abhor evil.
The LORD—Your loving devotion is in the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; Your judgments are a great deep. O the LORD, You preserve man and beast.
How precious is Your loving devotion, O God! Therefore the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings.
They are abundantly satisfied with the fatness of Your house, and You make them drink from the river of Your delights.
For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
Let not the foot of pride come against me, nor the hand of the wicked displace me.
There the evildoers have fallen; they are thrown down and cannot rise.
Do not let vexation consume you on account of evildoers, nor let envy gnaw at you toward those who perpetrate iniquity.
For they shall swiftly wither like grass and wilt like verdant herbage.
Trust in the LORD and do what is good; dwell in the land and nourish yourself with fidelity.
Delight yourself in the LORD, and He shall bestow upon you the desires of your heart.
Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He shall accomplish it.
He shall bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, and your justice like the noonday sun.
Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret over the one who prospers in his way, over the man who executes wicked machinations.
Desist from anger and forsake wrath; do not fret—it tends only to evil.
For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait upon the LORD shall inherit the land.
Yet a little while, and the wicked shall be no more; though you search for their place, they shall not be found.
But the meek shall inherit the land and delight in abundant peace.
The wicked plot against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them;
yet the Lord laughs at them, for He sees that their day is coming.
The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slaughter those whose conduct is upright.
But their own swords shall pierce their hearts, and their bows shall be shattered.
Better is the little that belongs to the righteous than the tumultuous abundance of many wicked.
For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance shall endure forever.
In the time of adversity they shall not be put to shame, and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
But the wicked shall perish; the enemies of the LORD shall vanish like the glory of the fields—they shall vanish like smoke.
The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and give.
For those blessed by Him shall inherit the land, but those cursed by Him shall be cut off.
The steps of a man are established by the LORD, and He delights in his way.
Though he fall, he shall not be cast down, for the LORD upholds his hand.
I have been young and am now old, yet I have never seen the righteous forsaken or their offspring begging bread.
They are ever generous and lend freely, and their descendants are blessed.
Turn from evil and do good, so that you may dwell in the land forever.
For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His godly ones; they are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked shall be cut off.
The righteous shall inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not slip.
The wicked lie in wait for the righteous and seek to slay them;
but the LORD will not abandon them to their power or let them be condemned when brought to trial.
Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He shall exalt you to inherit the land; you shall see it when the wicked are cut off.
I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a luxuriant native tree,
yet he passed away and was no more; though I sought him, he could not be found.
Mark the blameless and observe the upright, for a future belongs to the man of peace.
But transgressors shall be utterly destroyed; the future of the wicked shall be cut off.
The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.
The LORD helps them and delivers them; He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in Him.
O the LORD, do not rebuke me in Your wrath, nor chasten me in Your blazing anger.
For Your arrows have transfixed me, and Your hand has descended heavily upon me.
There is no soundness in my flesh because of Your indignation; there is no peace in my bones because of my sin.
For my iniquities have surged above my head; like an unbearable burden, they weigh me down.
My wounds have putrefied and festered because of my folly.
I am bent double and bowed down exceedingly; all day long I walk about in mourning.
For my loins are inflamed with affliction, and there is no soundness in my flesh.
I am utterly enfeebled and crushed; I groan because of the tumult of my heart.
O Lord, all my yearning is before You, and my sighing is not concealed from You.
My heart throbs, my strength has forsaken me, and even the light of my eyes has failed.
My friends and companions stand aloof from my affliction, and my kinsmen keep their distance.
Those who seek my life set snares; those who pursue my ruin speak of devastation and meditate deceit all day long.
But I am like a deaf man who does not hear, and like a mute who does not open his mouth.
Thus I have become as one who hears nothing, and in whose mouth there is no reproof.
For in You, O the LORD, I wait in hope; You will answer, O Lord my God.
For I have said, “Lest they rejoice over me; when my foot slips, they magnify themselves against me.”
For I am ready to fall, and my pain is continually before me.
For I will declare my iniquity; I am anxious because of my sin.
But my enemies are vigorous and strong, and those who hate me without cause are multiplied.
Those who repay evil for good are hostile to me, because I pursue what is good.
Do not forsake me, O the LORD; O my God, do not be far from me.
Make haste to my aid, O Lord, my salvation.
I said, “I will guard my ways so that I do not sin with my tongue; I will restrain my mouth as with a muzzle while the wicked stand before me.”
I was utterly silent; I held back even from speaking what was good, and my grief was inflamed.
My heart burned within me; as I mused, the fire kindled, and then I spoke with my tongue.
The LORD, make me to know my end, and the measure of my days, that I may know how transient I am.
Behold, You have measured out my days in handbreadths, and my whole span is as nothing before You; surely all mankind at its best is but a breath. Selah.
Surely a man walks as a mere shadow; surely they bustle about in vain; he heaps up wealth and does not know who will gather it.
And now, O Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in You.
Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me an object of scorn to the fool.
I was mute; I did not open my mouth, for You have done it.
Remove Your affliction from me; I am consumed by the stroke of Your hand.
When You discipline a man with rebukes for iniquity, You consume his prized possessions like a moth; surely all mankind is but a breath. Selah.
Hear my prayer, O the LORD; give ear to my cry; do not be deaf to my tears; for I am a stranger with You, a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
Turn Your gaze from me, that I may find relief, before I depart and am no more.
I waited with unwavering patience for the LORD, and He inclined toward me and heard my cry for help.
He drew me up from the pit of tumult, from the miry clay, and He set my feet upon a rock, making my steps secure.
He placed a new song in my mouth—a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and stand in awe, and they will place their confidence in the LORD.
Blessed is the person who makes the LORD his refuge, who does not turn toward the arrogant or to those who stray into falsehood.

Many are the wonders You have wrought, O the LORD my God, and Your purposes toward us are beyond reckoning; none can be compared to You. Were I to proclaim and recount them, they would elude any complete enumeration.
You have not delighted in sacrifice and offering; You have opened my ears to hear. You have not demanded burnt offerings and sin offerings.
Then I said, “Here I am; I have come, as it is written concerning me in the scroll of the book.
I take delight in doing Your will, O my God; Your law resides in the depths of my being.”
I have proclaimed abundant righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I have not restrained my lips—O the LORD, You know it well.
I have not hidden Your righteousness within my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and Your deliverance. I have not withheld Your steadfast love and Your truth from the great assembly.
Do not withhold Your mercy from me, O the LORD; may Your steadfast love and faithfulness continually guard me.
For innumerable calamities have encircled me; my iniquities have overtaken me, and I can no longer lift up my eyes. They outnumber the hairs of my head, and my heart fails within me.
Be pleased, O the LORD, to deliver me; hasten, O the LORD, to my aid.
Let those who seek to destroy my life be altogether ashamed and confounded; let those who delight in my harm be turned back and disgraced.
Let them be appalled because of their disgrace—those who say to me, “Aha, aha!”
May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation continually declare, “The LORD be magnified!”
As for me, I am poor and needy, but the Lord takes thought for me. You are my help and my deliverer; do not delay, O my God.
For the choirmaster—a psalm of David. Blessed is the one who exhibits prudent discernment toward the indigent; the LORD will deliver him in the day of adversity.
The LORD will guard him and preserve his life; he will be acclaimed as blessed in the land, and You will not surrender him to the machinations of his adversaries.
The LORD will sustain him upon a bed of sickness; You have transformed his entire couch throughout his illness.
As for me, I said, "the LORD, be gracious to me; heal my soul, for I have sinned against You!"
My enemies speak malevolently concerning me: "When will he die, and his name perish?"
And if one comes to visit me, he utters falsehood; his heart hoards iniquity within itself; when he departs, he disseminates it.
All who hate me conspire in whispers against me; against me they devise calamity.
"A deadly plague is poured out upon him, and now that he lies down, he will not rise again."
Even my intimate friend, in whom I trusted, who shared my bread, has betrayed me.
But You, the LORD, be gracious to me, and raise me up, that I may requite them!
By this I know that You delight in me: my enemy will not shout in triumph over me.
But You have upheld me because of my integrity, and You have established me in Your presence forever.
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! Amen and Amen.
Just as a deer pants for flowing streams, so my soul pants for You, O God.
My soul thirsts for God, for the living God; when shall I come and behold the face of God?
My tears have been my sustenance day and night, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
These things I remember as I pour out my soul within me: how I would go with the multitude, leading the procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and thanksgiving among the festive throng.
Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God; for I shall yet praise Him for the help of His presence.
O my God, my soul is bowed down within me; therefore I remember You from the land of the Jordan and the peaks of Hermon—even from Mount Mizar.
One depth of affliction calls to another at the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and Your waves have swept over me.
By day the LORD ordains His loving devotion, and at night His song is with me—a prayer to the God of my life.
I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
Like a deadly wound in my bones, my adversaries taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God; for I shall yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
Vindicate me, O God, and champion my cause against an impious nation; deliver me from the machinations of deceitful and iniquitous men.
For You are the God of my strength; why have You cast me aside? Why must I traverse my days in mourning beneath the oppression of my adversary?
Dispatch Your light and Your truth; let them conduct me, and let them usher me into Your holy mountain and into Your dwelling places.
Then shall I approach the altar of God, even God, the exultation of my gladness; and I shall extol You with the harp, O God, my God.
Why are you downcast, O my soul, and why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God, for I shall yet extol Him, the salvation of my countenance and my God.
We have heard with our ears, O God, what our fathers recounted to us—the deeds You performed in their days, in days of old.
With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted them; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.
For they did not take the land by their sword, nor did their arm secure victory for them; rather, it was Your right hand, Your arm, and the radiance of Your face, because You favored them.
You are my King, O God; ordain victories for Jacob.
Through You we repel our adversaries; in Your name we trample our foes.
For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword deliver me.
For You save us from our foes and put to shame those who hate us.
In God we have boasted all day long, and we will give thanks to Your name forever. Selah
Yet You have rejected and humiliated us; You no longer go forth with our armies.
You made us retreat before the enemy, and those who hate us have plundered us.
You gave us up like sheep to be devoured; You scattered us among the nations.
You sold Your people for nothing; You gained no profit from their sale.
You made us a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and derision to those around us.
You made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,
because of the voice of the taunter and reviler, because of the enemy and avenger.
All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten You or dealt falsely with Your covenant.
Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.
Yet You have crushed us in the haunt of jackals and covered us with deepest darkness.
If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
would not God have discovered it, since He knows the secrets of the heart?
Yet for Your sake we are killed all day long; we are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
Awake, O Lord! Why do You sleep? Arise! Do not reject us forever.
Why do You hide Your face and forget our misery and oppression?
For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.
Rise up; be our help! Redeem us for the sake of Your loving devotion.

For the choirmaster, according to Lilies, a maskil of the sons of Korah, a love song: my heart overflows with a noble theme; I recite my verses for the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful scribe.
You are the most handsome of men; grace is poured upon Your lips; therefore God has blessed You forever.
Strap Your sword upon Your thigh, O mighty one, in Your splendor and majesty.
In Your majesty ride forth victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness; let Your right hand display awesome deeds.
Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s enemies; the peoples fall beneath You.
Your throne, O God, is forever and ever; a scepter of justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You with the oil of gladness above Your companions.
All Your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from ivory palaces stringed instruments make You glad.
Kings’ daughters are among Your honored women; at Your right hand stands the queen in gold of Ophir.
Listen, O daughter, consider and incline your ear; forget your people and your father’s house.
And the king will desire your beauty. Since he is your lord, bow down to him.
The daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.
All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.
In embroidered garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions follow her—those brought to You.
They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.
Your sons will take the place of your fathers; You will make them princes in all the earth.
I will perpetuate Your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise You forever and ever.
God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of distress.
Therefore we shall not fear, though the earth be convulsed and the mountains be cast into the heart of the seas,
though its waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in its surge. Selah.
There is a river whose streams gladden the city of God, the holy habitation of the Most High.
God is within her; she shall not be moved. God will succor her when morning dawns.
The nations roar, the kingdoms falter; He utters His voice, and the earth melts.
The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah.
Come, behold the works of the LORD, how He has wrought desolation upon the earth.
He makes wars cease unto the ends of the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the chariots with fire.
"Cease your striving, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations; I will be exalted in the earth."
The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah.
Clap your hands, all you peoples; lift up a jubilant shout unto God.
For the LORD Most High is awe-inspiring, the great King over all the earth.
He subjugates nations beneath us, and peoples beneath our feet.
He ordains our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah
God has ascended amid shouts of jubilation, the LORD amid the sounding of trumpets.
Sing praises unto God, sing praises; sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
For God is King over all the earth; sing praises with discernment.
God reigns over the nations; God is seated upon His holy throne.
The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham, for the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.
The LORD is supremely great, and most worthy of exalted praise in the city of our God, upon His holy mountain.
Mount Zion—beautiful in its loftiness and the delight of all the earth—lies in the northern reaches, the city of the great King.
God dwells within her strongholds; He is renowned as a fortress.
For the kings gathered together and advanced in concert.
They beheld it and were seized with astonishment; they fled in terror.
Trembling overtook them there—anguish akin to a woman’s labor pangs.
With an east wind You shattered the ships of Tarshish.
As we have heard, so now have we beheld in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish her forever. Selah.
Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your steadfast love.
As Your name, O God, so Your praise extends to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is filled with righteousness.
Mount Zion rejoices, and the daughters of Judah exult, on account of Your judgments.
Circumnavigate Zion and tally her towers; inspect her ramparts and scrutinize her citadels,
so that you may recount them to the next generation,
declaring that this God is our God forever and ever; He will guide us even unto death.
Hear this, all you peoples; give ear, all you who dwell in the world.
Both those of humble birth and those of exalted station, the rich and the poor together.
My mouth shall speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart shall yield understanding.
I will incline my ear to a proverb and expound my riddle to the accompaniment of the lyre.
Why should I fear in evil days, when treacherous wickedness surrounds me?
Those who trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches—
no one can redeem a brother, nor give God a ransom for him—
for the redemption of a life is too costly, and no payment is ever enough—
that he should live on forever and never see decay.
For all can see that the wise die, and that the fool and the senseless perish alike, leaving their wealth to others.
Their graves are their homes forever, their dwellings for endless generations, though they have named lands after themselves.
Yet a man, however rich, does not endure; he is like the beasts that perish.
Such is the way of the self-assured, and those who follow them applaud their words. Selah.
Like sheep they are destined for Sheol; death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall rule over them in the morning, and their form shall waste away in Sheol, far from their splendor.
But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for He will receive me. Selah.
Do not be afraid when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases;
for when he dies he will carry nothing away, and his wealth will not descend with him.
For while he lives he congratulates himself, and people praise you whenever you prosper;
he will join the generation of his fathers, who will never again see the light.
A man who has riches without understanding is like the beasts that perish.
A psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from the east to the west.
From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.
