He has enfeebled my strength along the way and shortened my days.
I say, "O my God, do not take me away in the midst of my days; Your years endure through all generations."
Long ago You founded the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
They shall perish, but You shall remain; they shall all wear out like a garment. You will change them like clothing, and they will be changed.
But You are the same, and Your years will never come to an end.
The children of Your servants will dwell in Your presence, and their offspring will be established before You.
Bless the LORD, O my soul, and all that is within me, bless His holy name.
Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget any of His benefits—
He who pardons all your iniquity and heals all your diseases,
who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with steadfast love and mercy,
who satiates your desires with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's.
The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all who are oppressed.
He disclosed His ways to Moses, His deeds to the children of Israel.
The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love.
He will not perpetually contend, nor will He retain His anger forever.
He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us according to our iniquities.
For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His steadfast love toward those who fear Him;
as far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
As a father shows compassion to his children, so the LORD shows compassion to those who fear Him.
For He knows our frame; He remembers that we are but dust.
As for mortals, their days are like grass; they flourish like a flower of the field;
the wind passes over it, and it is gone, and its place acknowledges it no more.
But the steadfast love of the LORD endures from everlasting to everlasting upon those who fear Him, and His righteousness unto children's children,
to those who keep His covenant and remember to fulfill His commandments.
The LORD has established His throne in the heavens, and His kingdom governs all.
Bless the LORD, you His angels, mighty in strength, who do His word, obeying the voice of His word.
Bless the LORD, all His hosts, His ministers who do His will.
Bless the LORD, all His works, in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
Bless the LORD, O my soul. O the LORD my God, You are surpassingly great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent.
He lays the beams of His upper chambers in the waters; He makes the clouds His chariot; He walks upon the wings of the wind.
He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His ministers.
He founded the earth upon its foundations, that it should not be moved forever and ever.
You covered it with the deep as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
At your rebuke they fled; at the thunder of your voice they hastened away.
The mountains rose up; the valleys sank down to the place You had appointed for them.
You set a boundary they shall not transgress, nor shall they return to overwhelm the earth.
He sends forth springs into the watercourses; they wind among the hills.
They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild asses slake their thirst.
The birds of the heavens make their abode beside them and utter their voices among the foliage.
He waters the mountains from His upper chambers; the earth is satiated with the fruit of His works.
He causes grass to spring up for the cattle, and herbage for the service of man, that he may bring forth bread from the earth,
and wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil to make his face radiant, and bread that fortifies the heart.
The trees of the the LORD are abundantly watered, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted.
There the birds build their nests; the stork makes its dwelling in the fir trees.
The high mountains are for the wild goats; the crags are a refuge for the rock badgers.
He appointed the moon for seasons; the sun knows its setting.
You make darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest creep forth.
The young lions roar after their prey, seeking their food from God.
When the sun rises, they withdraw and lie down in their lairs.
Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.
How manifold are your works, O the LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
There is the sea, vast and spacious, wherein are innumerable creeping things, beasts both small and great.
There go the ships; Leviathan, which You formed to sport in it.
All of these look to You to give them their food in due season.
When You give to them, they gather it up; when You open your hand, they are filled with good things.
When You hide your face, they are dismayed; when You take away their breath, they expire and return to their dust.
When You send forth your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the ground.
May the glory of the the LORD endure forever; may the the LORD rejoice in His works.
He looks upon the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
I will sing to the the LORD throughout my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have being.
May my meditation be pleasing to Him; I will rejoice in the the LORD.
May sinners be consumed from the earth, and the wicked be no more. Bless the the LORD, O my soul. Praise the the LORD!
Give thanks to the LORD, invoke His name, and proclaim His mighty deeds among the peoples.
Sing to Him, chant psalms to Him, and meditate upon all His wondrous works.
Exult in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
Seek the LORD and His strength; pursue His presence without ceasing.
Remember the marvels He has wrought, His portents and the judgments uttered by His mouth,
O offspring of Abraham His servant, children of Jacob His chosen.
He is the LORD our God; His judgments prevail throughout the whole earth.
He remembers His covenant forever, the promise He ordained for a thousand generations—
the covenant He struck with Abraham and the oath He swore to Isaac.
He ratified it for Jacob as an ordinance, for Israel as a covenant in perpetuity,
saying, "I will give you the land of Canaan as the measured allotment of your inheritance."
When they were but a handful, few in number and sojourners within it,
they wandered from nation to nation, from one realm to another people.
He allowed no mortal to oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf.
"Do not touch My anointed ones, and do My prophets no harm."
He summoned famine upon the land and shattered every staff of bread.
He sent a man before them—Joseph—sold into slavery.
They afflicted his feet with shackles; his soul was confined in iron.
Until the appointed time, when his word came to pass, the word of the LORD tested him.
The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
He appointed him master of his household and steward of all his possessions,
to bind his princes at his discretion and to impart wisdom to his elders.
Then Israel entered Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
The LORD made His people exceedingly fruitful and stronger than their adversaries.
He turned their hearts to hate His people, to deal treacherously with His servants.
He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron whom He had chosen.
They performed His signs among them and wonders in the land of Ham.
He sent darkness and made it dark, and they did not defy His words.
He turned their waters into blood and slew their fish.
Their land teemed with frogs, even in the royal chambers.
He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and gnats throughout all their territory.
He gave them hail for rain and blazing fire upon their land.
He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their borders.
He spoke, and locusts came—young locusts beyond number—
and they devoured every herb in their land and consumed the fruit of their soil.
He struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their strength.
He brought His people out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
Egypt rejoiced at their departure, for terror of them had fallen upon it.
He spread a cloud for a covering and fire to illumine the night.
They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with bread from heaven.
He opened the rock, and waters gushed forth; they ran in the arid wastes like a river.
For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.
He brought out His people with gladness, His chosen with shouts of joy.
He gave them the lands of the nations, and they inherited the toil of the peoples,
that they might keep His statutes and observe His laws. Praise the LORD!
Hallelujah. Render thanksgiving unto the LORD, for He is benevolent; indeed, His covenantal lovingkindness persists in perpetuity.
Who possesses the eloquence to articulate the LORD’s mighty deeds, or to proclaim the entirety of His praise?
Blessed are they who uphold judicial equity and practice righteousness in every season.
Remember me, O the LORD, in Your favor toward Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
that I might behold the felicity of Your elect, exult in the jubilation of Your nation, and triumph alongside Your heritage.
We have sinned in concert with our forebears; we have wrought iniquity; we have acted with consummate wickedness.
Our forebears in Egypt did not apprehend Your marvelous deeds; they failed to remember the plenitude of Your mercy, and instead rebelled at the Red Sea.
Nevertheless, He delivered them for the sake of His name, to make manifest His omnipotence.
He rebuked the Red Sea, so that it desiccated, and He conducted them through the abyss as though through a desert.
Thus He rescued them from the grasp of the adversary and ransomed them from the power of the enemy.
The waters overwhelmed their oppressors, so that not a single one survived.
Then they gave credence to His utterances and intoned His praise.
Yet they swiftly forgot His deeds and refused to await His counsel.
Rather, they indulged a licentious craving in the wilderness and subjected God to trial in the wasteland.
He granted their petition, yet dispatched a wasting sickness into their souls.
When envy arose in the encampment against Moses and against Aaron, the holy one of the LORD,
the earth yawned open and engulfed Dathan, then concealed the assembly of Abiram.
Moreover, a conflagration erupted among their company, and the blaze devoured the wicked.
At Horeb they fashioned a calf and prostrated themselves before a molten image.
They bartered away their glory for the likeness of a grass-consuming ox.
They forgot God, their Savior, who had wrought stupendous deeds in Egypt,
marvelous works in the land of Ham, and terrifying wonders at the Red Sea.
Consequently, He declared that He would annihilate them—had not Moses, His elect, stationed himself in the breach before Him to avert His wrath from their destruction.
Thereafter they disdained the desirable land, placing no confidence in His promise.
They grumbled within their tents and refused to heed the voice of the LORD.
Therefore He lifted His hand and swore that He would cause them to perish in the wilderness,
and that He would cast their seed among the nations, dispersing them throughout foreign territories.
Then they yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and partook of sacrifices consecrated to the dead.
By their practices they provoked the LORD to wrath, and a pestilence erupted in their midst.
Then Phinehas arose and interposed, and the plague was arrested.
And this was reckoned unto him as righteousness for all generations in perpetuity.
They provoked Him at the waters of Meribah, and Moses suffered affliction on their account,
because they embittered his spirit, so that he uttered precipitous words with his lips.
They failed to exterminate the peoples, as the LORD had commanded them,
but instead intermingled with the nations and assimilated their practices.
They venerated their idols, which devolved into a snare for them.
They immolated their sons and daughters unto demons.
They shed innocent blood—the blood of their sons and daughters—whom they offered to the idols of Canaan, so that the land was defiled by bloodshed.
Thus they were polluted by their conduct and prostituted themselves through their practices.
Then the wrath of the LORD was inflamed against His people, and He abominated His inheritance;
He delivered them into the hand of the nations, so that their adversaries exercised dominion over them.
Their enemies subjugated and afflicted them, reducing them to submission beneath their power.
On numerous occasions He rescued them, yet they persisted in rebellious counsel and were debased by their iniquity.
Nevertheless, He regarded their affliction when He heard their supplication.
For their sake He remembered His covenant and relented in accordance with the magnitude of His mercy.
He also caused them to find compassion in the sight of all their captors.
Deliver us, O the LORD our God, and assemble us from among the nations, that we may render thanksgiving to Your holy name and exult in Your praise.
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from eternity unto eternity! And let all the people declare, “Amen!” Hallelujah!
Render thanksgiving unto the LORD, for He is good; indeed, His steadfast love endures forever.
Let the redeemed of the LORD proclaim it—namely, that He ransomed them from the hand of the adversary.
He gathered them from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
They wandered in the wilderness, in a desolate waste, finding no road to a city of habitation.
Hungry and thirsty, their very lives were ebbing within them.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their distress, and He delivered them from their afflictions.
He led them by a straight path, that they might journey toward a city for habitation.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for His steadfast love, and for His wonders to the children of men.
For He satisfied the longing soul and filled the hungry soul with good.
Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and in irons,
because they had rebelled against the words of God and spurned the counsel of the Most High.
Therefore He subdued their heart with toil; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them out of their distresses.
He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and burst their bonds asunder.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for His steadfast love, and for His wonders to the children of men.
For He has shattered the doors of bronze and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
Fools, because of their rebellious way and their iniquities, were afflicted;
their soul abhorred all food, and they drew near to the gates of death.
Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them out of their distresses.
He sent His word and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for His steadfast love, and for His wonders to the children of men.
Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare His works with rejoicing.
Those who descend to the sea in ships, who conduct their business upon the great waters—
these have seen the works of the LORD and His wonders in the deep.
For He spoke, and He raised up a stormy wind, and it lifted up the waves thereof.
They mounted up to the heavens and descended to the depths; their soul melted away in their misery.
They reeled and staggered like a drunken man, and all their wisdom was swallowed up.
Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distresses.
He made the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof were still.
Then they were glad because they were quiet, and He guided them to their desired haven.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for His steadfast love, and for His wonders to the children of men.
Let them exalt Him in the congregation of the people, and praise Him in the assembly of the elders.
He turns rivers into a wilderness, and springs of water into thirsty ground;
a fruitful land into a salt waste, because of the wickedness of those who dwell therein.
He turns the wilderness into a pool of water, and dry land into springs of water.
And there He makes the hungry to dwell, that they may establish a city for habitation,
and sow fields, and plant vineyards, and obtain a fruitful harvest.
He blesses them, so that they multiply greatly, and He does not let their cattle decrease.
Yet they are diminished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
He pours contempt upon princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
But He sets the needy on high away from affliction, and makes their families like a flock.
The upright see it and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
Whoever is wise, let him observe these things, and let him consider the steadfast love of the LORD.
A song, a psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music—indeed, with all my glory.
Awake, O harp and lyre! I will rouse the dawn.
I will extol You, O the LORD, among the peoples; I will sing Your praises among the nations.
For Your steadfast love is exalted above the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches unto the clouds.
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens, and let Your glory be above all the earth.
Answer me, and save with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
God has spoken in His holiness: “I will exult; I will apportion Shechem and measure out the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is the helmet upon My head; Judah is My scepter.
Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I will cast My sandal; over Philistia I will shout in triumph.”
Who will conduct me into the fortified city? Who will guide me unto Edom?
Have You not rejected us, O God? And will You not march forth with our armies?
Grant us succor against the adversary, for vain is the salvation of man.
Through God we shall do valiantly, and He will tread down our adversaries.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, do not be silent,
for the mouths of the wicked and the deceitful have opened against me; they have spoken against me with lying tongues.
They encircle me with words of hatred and assail me without cause.
In return for my love they accuse me, though I remain devoted to prayer.
They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
Appoint a wicked man over him, and let an accuser stand at his right hand.
When he is brought to judgment, let him emerge condemned, and let his prayer be reckoned as sin.
May his days be few, and may another take his office.
May his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
May his children wander as beggars and implore alms; may they seek sustenance from their ruined homes.
May the creditor seize all that he possesses, and may strangers plunder the fruit of his toil.
May no one extend mercy to him, nor show favor to his fatherless children.
May his posterity be cut off, and may their name be blotted out in the next generation.
May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and may the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
May they stand perpetually before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.
For he did not remember to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and the brokenhearted, seeking to put them to death.
Because he loved cursing, may it come upon him; because he took no delight in blessing, may it remain far from him.
He clothed himself in cursing as in a garment; may it enter his inward parts like water and penetrate his bones like oil.
May it be to him like the cloak he wears and like the belt he constantly fastens around himself.
May this be the LORD’s retribution to my accusers, to those who speak evil against my life.
But You, O the LORD, the Lord, deal graciously with me for the sake of Your name; because Your steadfast love is good, deliver me.
For I am poor and needy, and my heart is stricken within me.
I vanish like a shadow at its lengthening; I am shaken off like a locust.
My knees grow weak from fasting, and my flesh has grown lean for lack of oil.
I have become a reproach to them; when they see me, they shake their heads.
Help me, O the LORD my God; save me according to Your lovingkindness.
Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O the LORD, have done it.
They may curse, but You will bless; when they rise up, they will be put to shame, while Your servant rejoices.
May my accusers be clothed with disgrace and wrapped in their own shame as in a robe.
With my mouth I will give great thanks to the LORD; I will praise Him in the midst of the multitude.
For He stands at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who condemn his soul.
The LORD declares to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I subdue Your enemies and place them beneath Your feet.”
The LORD will extend Your mighty scepter from Zion; rule in the midst of Your enemies.
Your people will offer themselves willingly in the day of Your power; in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, You have the dew of Your youth.
The LORD has sworn an oath and will not relent: “You are a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.”
The Lord is at Your right hand; He will shatter kings in the day of His wrath.
He will execute judgment among the nations, filling them with corpses; He will crush the ruler over a vast territory.
He will drink from the brook beside the road; therefore He will lift up His head.
Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
The works of the LORD are great, diligently studied by all who delight in them.
Splendor and majesty are His work, and His righteousness endures forever.
He has made His wondrous works to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and merciful.
He gives food to those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
He has shown His people the power of His works, to give them the inheritance of the nations.
The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy,
established forever and ever, accomplished in truth and uprightness.
He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who practice His precepts have good understanding. His praise endures forever.
Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD and finds profound delight in His commandments.
His descendants shall be mighty in the land, and the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
Wealth and abundance reside in his household, while his righteousness stands in perpetuity.
For the upright, light arises amid the darkness—gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
It is good for the man who is gracious and lends; he conducts his affairs with justice.
For he shall never be shaken, and the righteous shall be remembered forever.
He will not fear evil tidings; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
His heart is secure; he will not be afraid until he beholds his adversaries with triumph.
He has dispersed his bounty to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his renown will be exalted in honor.
The wicked man will see and be vexed; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desire of the wicked will perish.
Praise the the LORD! Praise Him, O servants of the the LORD; praise the name of the the LORD.
Blessed be the name of the the LORD from this present hour even unto the ages of ages.
From the sun’s rising unto its setting, the name of the the LORD is to be extolled.
The The LORD is exalted above all nations, and His glory transcends the heavens.
Who is comparable unto the the LORD our God, enthroned on high,
who deigns to gaze upon the heavens and the earth?
He raises the indigent from the dust and lifts the destitute from the ash heap,
to seat them among princes, among the princes of His people.
He grants the barren woman a dwelling, making her a joyful mother of children. Praise the the LORD!
When Israel departed from Egypt, and the house of Jacob from a nation whose speech was alien,
Judah became His sanctuary, and Israel His dominion.
The sea beheld it and fled; the Jordan turned back.
The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
What disquiets you, O sea, that you flee? What turns you back, O Jordan?
What moves you, O mountains, to skip like rams, and you, O hills, like lambs?
Tremble, O earth, before the Lord, before the God of Jacob,
who turns the rock into a pool of water and the flint into a fountain of waters.
Not unto us, O the LORD, not unto us, but unto Your name give glory, for the sake of Your steadfast love, for the sake of Your faithfulness.
Why should the nations say, “Where, pray, is their God?”
Our God is in the heavens; He does whatever He pleases.
Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
They have mouths, but do not speak; eyes, but do not see.
They have ears, but do not hear; noses, but do not smell.
They have hands, but do not feel; feet, but do not walk; nor do they utter a sound through their throats.
Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
O Israel, trust in the the LORD; He is their help and their shield.
O house of Aaron, trust in the the LORD; He is their help and their shield.
You who fear the the LORD, trust in the the LORD; He is their help and their shield.
The LORD has remembered us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
He will bless those who fear the the LORD, both the small and the great.
May the the LORD increase you— you and your children.
You are blessed by the the LORD, Maker of heaven and earth.
The heavens are the heavens of the the LORD, but the earth He has given to the children of men.
The dead do not praise the the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
But we will bless the the LORD from this time forth and forevermore. Praise the the LORD!
I cherish the LORD, for He has heard my voice and my supplications.
Because He inclined His ear toward me, I shall invoke Him throughout all my days.
The cords of death encompassed me, and the pangs of Sheol seized me; I encountered distress and grief.
Then I called upon the name of the LORD: "O the LORD, I implore You, rescue my soul!"
The LORD is gracious and righteous, and our God is full of compassion.
The LORD preserves the guileless; I was brought low, and He delivered me.
Return, O my soul, to your rest, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling,
that I may walk before the LORD in the lands of the living.
I kept faith even while I confessed, "I am sorely afflicted."
In my consternation I said, "Every human being is a liar."
How shall I repay the LORD for all His beneficence toward me?
I will lift up the cup of salvation and invoke the name of the LORD.
I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His faithful ones.
O the LORD, truly I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have loosed my bonds.
I will offer You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and invoke the name of the LORD.
I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,
in the courts of the LORD's house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD, all nations; extol Him, all peoples.
For His steadfast love has prevailed over us, and the truth of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His steadfast love endures forever.
Let Israel say, “His steadfast love endures forever.”
Let the house of Aaron say, “His steadfast love endures forever.”
Let those who fear the LORD say, “His steadfast love endures forever.”
Out of my distress I called to the LORD; the LORD answered me and set me free.
The LORD is on my side; I will not fear. What can mortals do to me?
The LORD is on my side as my helper; I shall look in triumph upon those who hate me.
It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in mortals.
It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
All nations surrounded me; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
They surrounded me, surrounded me on every side; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
They swarmed around me like bees; they blazed like fire among thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
I was pushed hard, so that I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
The LORD is my strength and my song; He has become my salvation.
Glad songs of salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly;
the right hand of the LORD is exalted; the right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”
I shall not die, but I shall live, and recount the deeds of the LORD.
The LORD has disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter through them and give thanks to the LORD.
This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.
I thank You, for You have answered me and have become my salvation.
The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
This is the LORD’s doing; it is marvelous in our eyes.
This is the day the LORD has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
Save us, we pray, O the LORD! O the LORD, we pray, give us success!
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD! We bless you from the house of the LORD.
The LORD is God, and He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords, up to the horns of the altar!
You are my God, and I will give thanks to You; You are my God, I will extol You.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His steadfast love endures forever.
How blessed are those whose path remains immaculate, who walk in the instruction of the LORD!
How blessed are those who preserve His testimonies and seek Him with an undivided heart,
who perpetrate no iniquity but walk in His ways.
You have ordained Your precepts for scrupulous observance.
O that my ways might be established so as to keep Your statutes!
Then shall I not be confounded when I regard all Your commandments.
I will praise You with an upright heart, as I learn Your righteous ordinances.
I will keep Your statutes; abandon me not utterly.
By what means may a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
With my whole heart I seek You; let me not wander from Your commandments.
I have treasured Your word in my heart, that I might not sin against You.
Blessed are You, O the LORD; teach me Your statutes.
With my lips I have declared all the ordinances of Your mouth.
In the way of Your testimonies I delight as much as in all riches.
I will meditate upon Your precepts and fix my eyes upon Your ways.
I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
Open my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of Your law.
I am a sojourner upon the earth; hide not Your commandments from me.
My soul is consumed with longing for Your ordinances at all times.
You rebuke the insolent, the accursed, who wander from Your commandments.
Remove from me scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.
Even though princes sit and conspire against me, Your servant will meditate upon Your statutes.
Your testimonies are my delight; they are my counselors.
My soul cleaves to the dust; give me life according to Your word.
When I recounted my ways, You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
Make me understand the way of Your precepts, and I will meditate upon Your wondrous works.
My soul melts away for sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.
Put false ways far from me and graciously teach me Your law.
I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I set Your ordinances before me.
I cling to Your testimonies, O the LORD; let me not be put to shame.
I will run in the way of Your commandments when You enlarge my heart.
Teach me, O the LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep it to the end.
Give me understanding, that I may keep Your law and observe it with my whole heart.
Lead me in the path of Your commandments, for I delight in it.
Incline my heart to Your testimonies, and not to selfish gain.
Turn my eyes from looking at worthless things, and give me life in Your ways.
Confirm to Your servant Your promise, that You may be feared.
Turn away the reproach that I dread, for Your ordinances are good.
Behold, I long for Your precepts; in Your righteousness give me life.
Let Your steadfast love come to me, O the LORD, Your salvation according to Your promise.
Then shall I have an answer for him who taunts me, for I trust in Your word.
And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, for my hope is in Your ordinances.
I will keep Your law continually, forever and ever.
And I shall walk in a wide place, for I have sought Your precepts.
I will also speak of Your testimonies before kings and shall not be put to shame.
For I find my delight in Your commandments, which I love.
I will lift up my hands toward Your commandments, which I love, and I will meditate upon Your statutes.
Remember Your word to Your servant, in which You have made me hope.
This is my comfort in my affliction, that Your promise gives me life.
The insolent utterly deride me, but I do not turn away from Your law.
When I think of Your ordinances from of old, I take comfort, O the LORD.
Hot indignation seizes me because of the wicked, who forsake Your law.
Your statutes have been my songs in the house of my sojourning.
I remember Your name in the night, O the LORD, and keep Your law.
This blessing has fallen to me, that I have kept Your precepts.
The LORD is my portion; I promise to keep Your words.
I entreat Your favor with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.
When I think on my ways, I turn my feet to Your testimonies.
I hasten and do not delay to keep Your commandments.
Though the cords of the wicked ensnare me, I do not forget Your law.
At midnight I rise to praise You, because of Your righteous ordinances.
I am a companion of all who fear You, of those who keep Your precepts.
The earth, O the LORD, is full of Your steadfast love; teach me Your statutes.
You have dealt well with Your servant, O the LORD, according to Your word.
Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.
Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I keep Your word.
You are good and do good; teach me Your statutes.
The insolent smear me with lies, but with my whole heart I keep Your precepts.
Their heart is unfeeling like fat, but I delight in Your law.
It is good for me that I was afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.
The law of Your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver pieces.
Your hands have made and fashioned me; give me understanding that I may learn Your commandments.
Those who fear You shall see me and rejoice, because I have hoped in Your word.
I know, O the LORD, that Your ordinances are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
Let Your steadfast love comfort me according to Your promise to Your servant.
Let Your mercy come to me, that I may live; for Your law is my delight.
Let the insolent be put to shame, because they have wronged me with falsehood; as for me, I will meditate upon Your precepts.
Let those who fear You turn to me, that they may know Your testimonies.
May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
My soul longs for Your salvation; I hope in Your word.
My eyes long for Your promise; I ask, "When will You comfort me?"
For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke, yet I have not forgotten Your statutes.
How many days must Your servant endure? When will You judge those who persecute me?
The insolent have dug pitfalls for me; they do not live according to Your law.
All Your commandments are sure; they persecute me with falsehood; help me!
They have almost made an end of me on earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
In Your steadfast love give me life, that I may keep the testimonies of Your mouth.
Forever, O the LORD, Your word is firmly fixed in the heavens.
Your faithfulness endures to all generations; You have established the earth, and it stands fast.
By Your ordinances they stand this day, for all things are Your servants.
If Your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have given me life.
I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
The wicked lie in wait to destroy me, but I consider Your testimonies.
I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is exceedingly broad.
Oh how I love Your law! It is my meditation all the day.
Your commandment makes me wiser than my enemies, for it is ever with me.
I have more understanding than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
I understand more than the aged, for I keep Your precepts.
I hold back my feet from every evil way, in order to keep Your word.
I do not turn aside from Your ordinances, for You have taught me.
How sweet are Your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
Through Your precepts I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous ordinances.
I am severely afflicted; give me life, O the LORD, according to Your word.
Accept my freewill offerings of praise, O the LORD, and teach me Your ordinances.
I hold my life in my hand continually, but I do not forget Your law.
The wicked have laid a snare for me, but I do not stray from Your precepts.
Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
I incline my heart to perform Your statutes forever, to the end.
I hate the double-minded, but I love Your law.
You are my hiding place and my shield; I hope in Your word.
Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
Uphold me according to Your promise, that I may live, and let me not be put to shame in my hope.
Hold me up, that I may be safe and have regard for Your statutes continually.
You spurn all who go astray from Your statutes, for their cunning is in vain.
All the wicked of the earth You discard like dross, therefore I love Your testimonies.
My flesh trembles for fear of You, and I am afraid of Your judgments.
I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
Give Your servant a pledge of good; let not the insolent oppress me.
My eyes long for Your salvation and for the fulfillment of Your righteous promise.
Deal with Your servant according to Your steadfast love, and teach me Your statutes.
I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
It is time for the LORD to act, for Your law has been broken.
Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even fine gold.
Therefore I consider all Your precepts to be right; I hate every false way.
Your testimonies are wonderful; therefore my soul keeps them.
The unfolding of Your words gives light; it imparts understanding to the simple.
I open my mouth and pant, because I long for Your commandments.
Turn to me and be gracious to me, as is Your way with those who love Your name.
Keep steady my steps according to Your promise, and let no iniquity get dominion over me.
Redeem me from man's oppression, that I may keep Your precepts.
Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
My eyes shed streams of tears, because people do not keep Your law.
Righteous are You, O the LORD, and right are Your ordinances.
In my distress I invoked the LORD, and He responded to me.
Rescue my soul, O the LORD, from mendacious lips and from a perfidious tongue.
What retribution shall be meted out to you, and what further affliction shall be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
The sharpened arrows of a mighty one, together with the glowing embers of the broom shrub.
Alas for me, for I sojourn in Meshech and dwell among the tents of Kedar.
For far too long my soul has dwelt with those who abhor peace.
I am disposed toward peace; yet whenever I speak, they are disposed toward war.
I raise my eyes toward the mountains—whence shall my help come?
My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
He will not suffer your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
Behold, the Protector of Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps.
The LORD is your Protector; the LORD is your Shade at your right hand.
The sun shall not smite you by day, nor the moon by night.
The LORD will keep you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
The LORD will guard your going out and your coming in, from this time forth and forevermore.
I rejoiced when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
Our feet have stood within your gates, O Jerusalem.
Jerusalem, built as a city compactly united,
is the place to which the tribes ascend—the tribes of the LORD—as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
For there thrones for judgment are established, the thrones of the house of David.
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.”
May peace be within your walls and tranquility within your citadels.
For the sake of my brothers and my companions, I will now speak peace within you.
For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
A song of ascents: I elevate my gaze unto You, enthroned in the heavens.

Behold, as the eyes of servants are fixed upon the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maidservant upon the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are fixed upon the LORD our God, until He grants us grace.
Be gracious to us, O the LORD, be gracious to us, for we are sated to overflowing with contempt.
Our soul is sated to overflowing with the derision of the complacent, with the scorn of the arrogant.
If the LORD had not been our ally—let Israel now declare—
if the LORD had not been our ally when mortals rose up against us,
then, when their wrath flared against us, they would have swallowed us alive.
Then the waters would have overwhelmed us, and the torrent would have swept over our soul;
then the arrogant waters would have passed over our soul.
Blessed be the LORD, who has not consigned us to be prey to their teeth.
Our soul has escaped like a bird from the fowler's snare; the snare is shattered, and we have been delivered.
Our help rests in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved but abides forever.
As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, from this time forth and forevermore.
For the rod of wickedness shall not rest upon the allotment of the righteous, lest the righteous extend their hands unto iniquity.
Do good, O the LORD, to the good, and to those upright in their hearts.
But those who turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD will lead away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.
When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dream.
Then our mouths were filled with laughter, and our tongues with songs of joy; then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
The LORD has done great things for us; we are glad.
Restore our fortunes, O the LORD, like torrents in the Negev!
Those who sow in tears shall reap with shouts of joy!
He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, shall come home with shouts of joy, bearing his sheaves.
Unless the LORD builds the house, those who build it labor in vain; unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman keeps vigil in vain.
It is futile for you to rise early and sit up late, toiling for bread; for He gives sleep to those He loves.
Behold, children are a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are the children of one's youth.
Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them; they shall not be put to shame when they contend with their enemies at the gate.
A Song of Ascents. Blessed is every one who fears the LORD, who walks in His ways.
You shall eat the fruit of your toil; you shall be blessed, and it shall be well with you.
Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine within the innermost recesses of your house, and your children like olive saplings encircling your table.
Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears the LORD.
The LORD bless you from Zion, that you may behold the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
And may you behold your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
“They have grievously afflicted me from my youth,” let Israel now declare—
“they have grievously afflicted me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against me.
The plowmen furrowed my back and lengthened their furrows.”
The LORD is righteous; He has severed the bonds of the wicked.
May all who hate Zion be humiliated and repulsed!
Let them become like grass upon the rooftops, which perishes before attaining maturity,
with which no reaper fills his hand and no binder of sheaves his arms,
so that wayfarers never say, “May the blessing of the LORD rest upon you! We bless you in the name of the LORD.”
From the abyssal depths I have cried out to You, the LORD;
O Lord, give heed to my voice, and let Your ears be attentively inclined to the voice of my supplications.
If You, the LORD, should keep a strict reckoning of iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
Yet with You there is forgiveness, that You may be revered.
I wait expectantly for the LORD; my soul waits, and in His word I place my hope.
My soul waits for the Lord more than sentinels wait for the dawn—more than sentinels for the morning.
O Israel, place your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD there is covenantal lovingkindness, and with Him is plenteous redemption.
And He will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
My heart, O the LORD, is not haughty; my eyes are not raised on high; neither have I busied myself in matters too great or too wondrous for me.
Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, as a weaned child upon his mother; my soul is as a weaned child.
O Israel, hope in the LORD from this time forth and forevermore.
A Song of Ascents. The LORD, remember David, together with all his affliction.
how he swore to the LORD and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
"I will not enter the tent of my house, nor ascend to the couch of my bed;
I will not grant sleep to my eyes, nor slumber to my eyelids,
until I have found a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."
Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
Let us go to His dwelling; let us worship at His footstool.
Arise, the LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
Let Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and let Your faithful ones shout for joy.
For the sake of David, Your servant, do not reject Your anointed.
The LORD has sworn to David in truth, and He will not retract it: "From the fruit of your body I will set one upon your throne.
If your sons keep My covenant and My testimonies that I will teach them, their sons also shall sit upon your throne forever."
For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His dwelling:
"This is My resting place forever; here I will dwell, for I have desired it.
I will abundantly bless her provision; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her faithful ones will shout aloud for joy.
There I will make a horn to sprout for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed.
I will clothe his enemies with shame, but upon him his crown will flourish."
A Song of Ascents, by David. Behold, how salutary and how delightful it is when brethren abide together in concord!
It is comparable to the precious oil upon the head, cascading down upon the beard—even Aaron's beard—descending to the collar of his garments.
It is comparable to the dew of Hermon descending upon the mountains of Zion; for there the the LORD ordained the blessing, even life unto eternity.
Behold, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who keep nocturnal vigil in the house of the LORD.
Lift up your hands in the sanctuary and bless the LORD.
May the LORD bless you from Zion—He who fashioned heaven and earth.
Extol the LORD! Extol the name of the LORD! Extol Him, O servants of the LORD,
who stand within the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
Extol the LORD, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is delightful.
For the LORD has chosen Jacob for Himself, Israel as His own treasured possession.
For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is exalted above all gods.
The LORD accomplishes all that He pleases, in heaven and on earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
He makes the clouds ascend from the ends of the earth; He fashions lightning for the rain and brings the wind forth from His storehouses.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, both human and beast.
He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
He struck down many nations and slew mighty kings—
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—
and gave their land as a heritage, a heritage to His people Israel.
O LORD, Your name endures forever; Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
For the LORD will vindicate His people and have compassion on His servants.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
They have mouths, yet they cannot speak; they have eyes, yet they cannot see.
They have ears, yet they cannot hear; indeed, no breath resides in their mouths.
Those who fashion them will become like them, as will all who place their trust in them.
O house of Israel, bless the LORD! O house of Aaron, bless the LORD!
O house of Levi, bless the LORD! You who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
Blessed be the LORD from Zion, He who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
Offer thanksgiving to the LORD, for He is good; for His loving devotion endures forever.
Offer thanksgiving to the God of gods, for His loving devotion endures forever.
Offer thanksgiving to the Lord of lords, for His loving devotion endures forever.
To Him who alone does great wonders, for His loving devotion endures forever.
To Him who by understanding made the heavens, for His loving devotion endures forever.
To Him who spread out the earth upon the waters, for His loving devotion endures forever.
To Him who made the great luminaries, for His loving devotion endures forever.
The sun to govern the day, for His loving devotion endures forever.
The moon and stars to govern the night, for His loving devotion endures forever.
To Him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, for His loving devotion endures forever.
And brought Israel out from among them, for His loving devotion endures forever.
With a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, for His loving devotion endures forever.
To Him who divided the Red Sea, for His loving devotion endures forever.
And led Israel through its midst, for His loving devotion endures forever.
But swept Pharaoh and his host into the Red Sea, for His loving devotion endures forever.
To Him who led His people through the wilderness, for His loving devotion endures forever.
To Him who struck down great kings, for His loving devotion endures forever.
And slew mighty kings, for His loving devotion endures forever.
Sihon king of the Amorites, for His loving devotion endures forever.
And Og king of Bashan, for His loving devotion endures forever.
And gave their land as an inheritance, for His loving devotion endures forever.
A heritage to Israel His servant, for His loving devotion endures forever.
To Him who remembered us in our low estate, for His loving devotion endures forever.
And delivered us from our enemies, for His loving devotion endures forever.
Who gives food to all flesh, for His loving devotion endures forever.
Offer thanksgiving to the God of heaven, for His loving devotion endures forever.
By the watercourses of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
Upon the willows within it we hung our lyres.
For there our captors demanded words of song from us, and our tormentors demanded mirth, saying, “Sing for us one of the songs of Zion.”
How, then, could we sing the song of the LORD upon alien soil?
If I forget you, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth, if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem above my chief joy.
Remember, O the LORD, against the sons of Edom the day of Jerusalem, when they said, “Raze it, raze it, even to its foundation!”
O daughter of Babylon, you who are doomed to devastation, blessed is the one who repays you the recompense you have dealt to us.
Blessed is the one who seizes your little ones and dashes them against the rock.
I shall render thanksgiving unto You with the entirety of my heart; in the presence of the gods I shall chant praises unto You.
I shall prostrate myself toward Your holy sanctuary, and I shall give thanks unto Your name for Your lovingkindness and Your faithfulness, for You have magnified Your word above all Your name.
On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me with strength within my soul.
All the kings of the earth shall give You thanks, O the LORD, for they have heard the words of Your mouth.
And they shall sing of the ways of the LORD, for great is the glory of the LORD.
For though the LORD is on high, He regards the lowly, but the haughty He knows from afar.
Though I walk in the midst of trouble, You will revive me; You will stretch out Your hand against the wrath of my enemies, and Your right hand will save me.
The LORD will bring to completion that which concerns me; Your lovingkindness, O the LORD, endures forever; do not forsake the works of Your hands.
The LORD, You have searched me and known me.
You know my sitting down and my rising up; You understand my thoughts from afar.
You scrutinize my path and my reclining, and You are intimately acquainted with all my ways.
For no utterance yet rests upon my tongue, but behold, the LORD, You know it in its entirety.
You have hemmed me in behind and before, and laid Your hand upon me.
Such knowledge is too wondrous for me; it is exalted, and I cannot attain unto it.
Whither shall I go from Your Spirit? Or whither shall I flee from Your presence?
If I ascend into heaven, You are there; if I spread my couch in Sheol, behold, You are there.
If I take the wings of the dawn, if I dwell at the sea's farthest bound,
even there Your hand shall guide me, and Your right hand shall hold me fast.
If I should say, "Surely darkness shall cover me, and the light turn to night about me,"
even the darkness is not dark to You; the night is bright as the day, for darkness is as light to You.
For You formed my inmost parts; You wove me together in my mother's womb.
I will praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made; wondrous are Your works, and my soul knows it full well.
My frame was not hidden from You when I was fashioned in secret, intricately wrought in the depths of the earth.
Your eyes beheld my unformed substance; in Your book were written all the days fashioned for me, before any of them came to pass.
How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God! How vast is the sum of them!
Were I to count them, they would outnumber the sand; when I awake, I am still with You.
O that You would slay the wicked, O God! Depart from me, you men of bloodshed!
They speak against You with malicious intent; Your enemies misuse Your name.
Do I not hate those who hate You, the LORD? And do I not contend with those who rise up against You?
I hate them with a perfect hatred; I count them my foes.
Search me, O God, and know my heart; try me, and know my anxious thoughts.
And see whether any way of grief is in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
Rescue me, O the LORD, from evil; guard me from men of violence,
who contrive iniquity within their hearts and foment strife without ceasing.
They whet their tongues like a serpent's; the venom of asps lies beneath their lips. Selah.
Keep me, O the LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from men of violence, who plot to make my steps falter.
The arrogant have concealed a snare for me; they have spread cords as a net; they have laid traps beside my path. Selah.
I have said to the LORD, "You are my God." Hear, O the LORD, the voice of my supplications.
O the LORD, my Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
Do not grant, O the LORD, the cravings of the wicked; do not let their schemes prosper, lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
May the heads of those who surround me be enveloped in the trouble their lips have wrought.
May burning coals be heaped upon them; may they be cast into the fire, into deep mire, from which they cannot arise.
Let not the slanderer be established in the land; let evil hunt down the violent man without relenting.
I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted and execute justice for the poor.
Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name; the upright shall dwell before your presence.
I cry out to You, O the LORD; hasten to my succor. Give ear to my voice when I invoke You.
May my prayer be established before You as incense, and the lifting up of my hands as the evening oblation.
Set a sentinel, O the LORD, over my mouth; guard the portal of my lips.
Do not permit my heart to be drawn toward evil, nor let me occupy myself with wicked machinations alongside men who perpetrate iniquity; and do not let me partake of their dainties.
Let the righteous strike me—it is an act of lovingkindness; let him rebuke me—it is oil upon my head; let not my head spurn it. For my prayer remains set against their wickedness.
Their magistrates are hurled down the crags, yet they heed my utterances, for they are pleasing.
As one who plows and fractures the soil, so our bones are strewn at the jaws of Sheol.
But my eyes are fixed upon You, O GOD the Lord; in You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
Preserve me from the snare they have contrived for me, and from the traps of evildoers.
Let the wicked fall into their own nets together, while I pass by unscathed.
I cry aloud to the LORD; with my voice I make supplication to the LORD.
I pour out my complaint in His presence; I declare my distress before Him.
When my spirit faints within me, You know my path; in the way I walk they have concealed a snare for me.
Look to my right and see—there is no one who recognizes me; refuge has failed me; no one inquires after my life.
I have cried out to You, O the LORD; I have said that You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.
Give ear to my supplication, for I am brought very low; deliver me from my persecutors, for they are stronger than I.
Bring my life out of confinement, that I may give thanks to Your name; the righteous will surround me, for You will deal bountifully with me.
Hear my prayer, O the LORD; incline Your ear to my supplications, and answer me in Your faithfulness and righteousness.
Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one living can be righteous before You.
For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushed my life to the ground, and consigned me to darkness like those long dead.
Consequently, my spirit is overwhelmed within me, and my heart is desolate within me.
I remember the days of antiquity; I meditate upon all Your works; I muse upon the work of Your hands.
I spread out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You as a parched land. Selah.
Answer me quickly, O the LORD; my spirit is spent. Do not hide Your face from me, lest I be reckoned among those who descend into the pit.
Cause me to hear Your lovingkindness in the morning, for I trust in You; make known to me the way I should walk, for I lift up my soul to You.
Deliver me, O the LORD, from my enemies; I have taken refuge in You.
Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God; may Your good Spirit guide me on level ground.
Revive me, O the LORD, for Your name's sake; in Your righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.
In Your mercy, cut off my enemies and destroy all who afflict my soul, for I am Your servant.
Blessed be the LORD, my Rock, who disciplines my hands for martial combat and my fingers for the fray;
He is my steadfast love and my Fortress, my Stronghold and my Deliverer, my Shield, in whom I take refuge, who subjugates my people beneath me.
O the LORD, what is mortal man that You should take cognizance of him, or a human being that You should esteem him?
Man is but a breath; his days are like a shadow that passes away.
Rend the heavens, O the LORD, and descend; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
Flash forth lightning and scatter them; launch Your arrows and put them to rout.
Reach down from on high; rescue me and deliver me from the surging waters, from the grasp of foreigners,
whose mouths utter deceit and whose right hands are pledged to falsehood.
I will sing to You a new song, O God; upon a ten-stringed harp I will make music to You.
He grants victory to kings; He delivers His servant David from the perilous sword.
Rescue me and deliver me from the grasp of foreigners, whose mouths utter deceit and whose right hands are pledged to falsehood.
Then our sons will be like well-nurtured saplings, and our daughters like pillars sculpted for the adornment of a palace.
Our granaries will be filled, furnishing produce of every sort; our flocks will multiply by thousands, by tens of thousands in our pastures.
Our oxen will be heavily laden; there will be no breach, no banishment, and no outcry in our thoroughfares.
Blessed are the people for whom this is so; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.
I will exalt You, my God and King, and I will bless Your name forever and ever.
Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever and ever.
Great is the LORD, and exceedingly to be praised; His greatness is unfathomable.
One generation shall praise Your works to another, and shall declare Your mighty acts.
On the glorious splendor of Your majesty and on Your wondrous works I will meditate.
They shall speak of the might of Your awesome deeds, and I will declare Your greatness.
They shall pour forth the renown of Your abundant goodness and sing of Your righteousness.
The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love.
The LORD is good to all, and His tender mercies are over all that He has made.
All Your works shall give thanks to You, O the LORD, and Your faithful ones shall bless You.
They shall speak of the glory of Your kingdom and tell of Your power,
to make known to the children of men Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom.
Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures throughout all generations.
The LORD upholds all who are falling and raises up all who are bowed down.
The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in due season.
You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
The LORD is righteous in all His ways and faithful in all His works.
The LORD is near to all who call upon Him, to all who call upon Him in truth.
He will fulfill the desire of those who fear Him; He will also hear their cry and save them.
The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD, and all flesh will bless His holy name forever and ever.
Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, O my soul!
I shall extol the LORD throughout my days; I shall chant psalms to my God while breath yet remains within me.
Do not repose your confidence in nobles, nor in mortal offspring, in whom no deliverance resides.
When his spirit departs, he returns to the dust; on that very day his designs perish.
Blessed is the one whose succor is the God of Jacob, whose hope is fixed upon the LORD his God—
the Artificer of heaven and earth, the sea, and all that dwells therein, who preserves fidelity in perpetuity;
who administers justice for the oppressed and dispenses sustenance to the famished. The LORD liberates captives;
the LORD grants sight to the blind; the LORD raises up those bowed beneath their burdens; the LORD cherishes the righteous.
The LORD safeguards sojourners; He sustains the orphan and the widow, yet He subverts the way of the wicked.
The LORD shall reign in perpetuity—your God, O Zion, throughout all generations. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD, for it is good; sing praises to our God, for it is pleasant, and praise is befitting.
The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.
He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
He counts the number of the stars; He calls them all by name.
Great is our Lord and mighty in power; His understanding is beyond measure.
The LORD lifts up the humble; He casts the wicked to the ground.
Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music to our God on the lyre.
He covers the sky with clouds; He provides rain for the earth and makes grass grow on the hills.
He gives food to the beasts and to the young ravens when they cry.
He does not delight in the strength of the horse, nor take pleasure in the legs of a man.
The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear Him, in those who hope in His steadfast love.
Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion!
For He strengthens the bars of your gates; He blesses your children within you.
He makes peace within your borders and satisfies you with the finest wheat.
He sends forth His command to the earth; His word runs swiftly.
He gives snow like wool; He scatters frost like ashes; He casts forth His hail like crumbs.
Who can stand before His cold?
He sends out His word and melts them; He makes His wind blow, and the waters flow.
He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and ordinances to Israel.
He has not dealt thus with any nation; they do not know His ordinances. Praise the LORD!
Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; extol Him in the loftiest heights.
Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His celestial hosts.
Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, every shining star.
Praise Him, highest heavens, and the waters beyond the heavens.
Let them extol the name of the LORD, for He issued the command, and they were brought into being.
He established them for all eternity; He promulgated a decree that shall never be revoked.
Praise the LORD from the earth—great sea creatures and all oceanic depths,
fire and hail, snow and vapor, and the storm wind executing His word;
mountains and every hill, fruit trees and all cedars;
wild beasts and all livestock, creeping things and winged birds.
Kings of the earth and all nations, princes and every judge of the earth;
young men and maidens together, the aged alongside children.
Let them extol the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor surpasses earth and heaven.
He has exalted a horn for His people—a renown for all His faithful, for the children of Israel, a people intimate with Him. Hallelujah!
Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, His praise in the assembly of the saints.
Let Israel exult in its Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
Let them praise His name with dance; let them make music to Him with tambourine and lyre.
For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the humble with salvation.
Let the saints exult in glory; let them sing for joy upon their beds.
Let the high praises of God be in their throats, and a two-edged sword in their hands,
to execute vengeance upon the nations and retribution upon the peoples,
to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with iron fetters,
to execute the judgment written against them. This is an honor for all His saints. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD! Praise God in His sanctuary; praise Him in the firmament of His power.
Praise Him for His mighty deeds; praise Him according to His surpassing greatness.
Praise Him with the blast of the shofar; praise Him with lute and harp.
Praise Him with timbrel and dance; praise Him with strings and flute.
Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.
Let every being that has breath praise the LORD. Praise the LORD!
The proverbs of Solomon, son of David, king of Israel:
to know wisdom and instruction, to discern the words of understanding;
to receive instruction in wisdom—righteousness, justice, and equity;
to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young;
a wise person hears and increases in learning, and a discerning person acquires guidance;
to understand a proverb and its interpretation, the words of the wise and their riddles.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge; fools despise wisdom and instruction.
Hear, my son, your father's instruction, and do not forsake your mother's teaching;
for they are a graceful garland for your head and pendants for your neck.
My son, if sinners entice you, do not consent.
If they say, "Come with us; let us lie in wait for blood; let us ambush the innocent without cause;
let us swallow them alive, as Sheol does, and whole, like those descending into the pit;
we shall find all precious wealth and fill our houses with spoil;
cast your lot in with us; we shall all share one purse"—
my son, do not walk in the way with them; restrain your foot from their path.
For their feet run to evil, and they hasten to shed blood.
For it is futile to spread a net in full view of a bird.
Yet they lie in wait for their own blood and ambush their own lives.
Such are the ways of all who are greedy for gain: greed takes the life of those who possess it.
Wisdom cries aloud in the street; in the squares she raises her voice.
At the head of the noisy streets she calls out; at the entrances of the gates, in the city, she speaks her words:
"How long, O simple ones, will you cling to simplicity? How long will scoffers delight in scoffing, and fools despise knowledge?
Turn back at my reproof; behold, I will pour out my spirit upon you, and I will make my words known to you.
Because I called and you refused, I stretched out my hand and no one paid attention.
You have neglected all my counsel and would have none of my reproof.
I in turn will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when terror strikes you,
when your terror comes like a storm and your calamity arrives like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish befall you.
Then they will call upon me, but I will not answer; they will seek me diligently, but they will not find me.
Because they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of the LORD,
they would not accept my counsel; they despised all my reproof.
Therefore they shall eat the fruit of their own way and be sated with their own devices.
For the backsliding of the simple will slay them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them.
But whoever listens to me will dwell securely and be tranquil, without dread of evil."
My son, if you receive my words and store up my commandments within you,
inclining your ear to wisdom and directing your heart toward understanding—
indeed, if you call out for insight and cry aloud for understanding,
and if you seek her as silver and search for her as for hidden treasures—
then you will comprehend the fear of the LORD and discover the knowledge of God.
For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth proceed knowledge and understanding.
He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
guarding the paths of justice and preserving the way of His saints.
Then you will discern righteousness, justice, and equity—indeed, every good path.
For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasing to your soul.
Discretion will watch over you, and understanding will guard you.

To rescue you from the way of evil and from men who speak perversities: those who forsake the paths of uprightness to walk in the ways of darkness, who delight in doing evil and exult in the perversities of evil, whose paths are crooked and who are devious in their ways.
To rescue you from the adulterous woman, from the wayward woman whose words are smooth—
she who forsakes the companion of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.
For her house sinks down to death, and her paths lead to the dead.
None who go in to her return, nor do they attain the paths of life.
Thus you will walk in the way of good men and keep to the paths of the righteous.
For the upright will dwell in the land, and the blameless will remain in it;
but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the treacherous will be uprooted from it.
My son, do not forget my instruction, but let your heart safeguard my commandments;
for they shall add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
Let not steadfast love and faithfulness abandon you; keep them ever near to your heart, and engrave them upon the tablet of your inner being.
Then you shall find favor and sound discernment in the sight of God and of humanity.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and do not repose confidence in your own understanding;
in every path acknowledge Him, and He will render your ways straight.
Do not deem yourself wise in your own judgment; revere the LORD and shun evil.
This shall be healing to your flesh and refreshment to your bones.
Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your produce;
then your barns shall be filled with plenty, and your vats shall overflow with new wine.
My son, do not despise the discipline of the LORD, nor grow weary of His reproof;
for whom the LORD loves He disciplines, just as a father delights in the son whom he has chosen.
Blessed is the one who finds wisdom, and the one who acquires understanding;
for her gain surpasses the gain of silver, and her yield exceeds fine gold.
She is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire can be set beside her.
Long life is in her right hand; in her left are riches and honor.
Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
She is a tree of life to those who seize her, and those who hold her fast are blessed.
The LORD founded the earth by wisdom; He established the heavens by understanding.
By His knowledge the deeps were cleft, and the skies distill dew.
My son, do not let them slip from your sight; keep prudence and discretion,
for they shall be life to your soul and favor to your life.
Then you shall walk securely, and you shall not falter.
When you lie down, you shall not be afraid; indeed, your sleep shall be sweet.
Do not fear sudden terror, nor the calamity that befalls the wicked when it comes;
for the LORD shall be your confidence, and He will keep you from the snare.
Do not withhold good from its rightful claimants when it is in your power to do it.
Do not say to your neighbor, "Go, and come back, and tomorrow I will give it," when you already have it with you.
Do not devise evil against your neighbor while he dwells beside you in security.
Do not contend with anyone without cause, if he has done you no harm.
Do not envy a man of violence, and choose none of his ways.
For the perverse are an abomination to the LORD, but His intimate counsel is with the upright.
The curse of the LORD is upon the house of the wicked, but He blesses the dwelling of the righteous.
He scorns the scornful, but gives grace to the humble.
The wise shall inherit glory, but fools exalt their own disgrace.
Hear, O sons, a father’s instruction, and attend that you may know understanding;
for I have given you sound doctrine—do not forsake my teaching.
For I was a son to my father, tender and uniquely cherished before my mother;
and he taught me and said to me, “Let your heart retain my words; keep my commandments, and live.”
Acquire wisdom; acquire understanding. Do not forget, nor turn aside from the words of my mouth.
Do not forsake her, and she will preserve you; love her, and she will keep you.
Wisdom is the principal thing: acquire wisdom, and with all your acquisitions, acquire understanding.
Prize her, and she will exalt you; she will honor you when you embrace her.
She will give to your head a garland of grace; a crown of glory she will deliver to you.
Hear, my son, and receive my sayings, and the years of your life will be multiplied to you.
I have taught you in the way of wisdom; I have led you in the paths of uprightness.
When you walk, your steps will not be constrained, and if you run, you will not stumble.
Hold fast to instruction; do not let it go; keep it, for it is your life.
Do not enter the path of the wicked, and do not go in the way of evil men.
Avoid it; do not pass by it; turn from it and pass on.
For they cannot sleep unless they do evil, and their sleep is taken from them unless they cause someone to stumble.
For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, shining ever brighter unto the perfect day.
The way of the wicked is like darkness; they do not know at what they stumble.
My son, attend to my words; incline your ear to my sayings.
Let them not depart from your eyes; keep them in the midst of your heart,
for they are life to those who find them, and healing to all their flesh.
Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it are the issues of life.
Put away from you perverseness of mouth, and put perverse lips far from you.
Let your eyes look straight ahead, and let your eyelids look directly before you.
Ponder the path of your feet, and all your ways will be established.
Do not turn to the right or to the left; remove your foot from evil.
My son, attend to my wisdom; incline your ear to my understanding.
So that you may preserve prudence, and your lips may safeguard knowledge.
For the lips of a wanton woman drip honey, and her palate is smoother than oil.
Yet her end is bitter as wormwood, and sharp as a two-edged sword.
Her feet descend into death, and her steps lay hold on Sheol.
She does not contemplate the path of life; her courses wander, and she is oblivious to it.
Now, therefore, my sons, hearken unto me, and do not depart from the words of my mouth.
Keep your way far from her, and do not approach the door of her house.
Lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel.
Lest strangers be sated with your strength, and your labors enrich a foreigner's house.
And you groan at your latter end, when your flesh and body are consumed.
And you say, “How I hated discipline, and my heart despised reproof!
I did not obey the voice of my teachers, nor incline my ear to my instructors.
I had nearly been consumed by every evil in the midst of the assembly and congregation.”
Drink water from your own cistern, and running water from your own well.
Should your springs be scattered abroad, your streams in the streets?
Let them be for you alone, and not for strangers with you.
Let your fountain be blessed, and rejoice in the wife of your youth.
A lovely deer, a graceful doe; let her breasts satisfy you at all times; be intoxicated always in her love.
Why, my son, should you be intoxicated with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a foreigner?
For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, and He makes level all his paths.
His own iniquities shall capture the wicked, and he shall be held with the cords of his sin.
He shall die for lack of discipline, and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
My son, if you have stood surety for your neighbor and pledged your hand on behalf of a stranger,
you are snared by the words of your mouth and taken captive by the words of your mouth.
